raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
**Stacked on #44626** (the target-side low-latency decode). Review only the last commit; this PR will be rebased after #44626 merges.

## Motivation

**Joint result vs `main`, all three PRs on one GB300 node in one job.** Each column adds one PR to the previous one: `main` (`c5a5bf0d0bd`), + #44626, + #44628, + #44627; each uses its own PR's launch command (Speed Tests below). TP4, DSpark with a fixed 3.51 accepted tokens per step, 8K input / 1K output tokens, closed loop at each concurrency; one server per column, two rounds (the second in reverse concurrency order), mean shown; % vs `main`. This PR is the **+ #44628** column.

| Concurrency | Metric | `main` | + #44626 | **+ #44628** | + #44627 |
| ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | Decode step p50 (ms) | 4.850 | 4.162 (-14.2%) | **4.062 (-16.2%)** | 4.082 (-15.8%) |
|  | tok/s/user p50 | 724 | 836 (+15.5%) | **864 (+19.3%)** | 864 (+19.3%) |
|  | Output tok/s | 641 | 723 (+12.8%) | **743 (+15.9%)** | 765 (+19.3%) |
|  | TTFT p50 (ms) | 187 | 188 (+0.5%) | **191 (+2.1%)** | 145 (-22.5%) |
| 2 | Decode step p50 (ms) | 5.735 | 4.623 (-19.4%) | **4.533 (-21.0%)** | 4.485 (-21.8%) |
|  | tok/s/user p50 | 614 | 754 (+22.8%) | **774 (+26.1%)** | 768 (+25.1%) |
|  | Output tok/s | 1,001 | 1,169 (+16.8%) | **1,209 (+20.8%)** | 1,281 (+28.0%) |
|  | TTFT p50 (ms) | 363 | 366 (+0.8%) | **365 (+0.6%)** | 280 (-22.9%) |
| 4 | Decode step p50 (ms) | 6.649 | 5.558 (-16.4%) | **5.460 (-17.9%)** | 5.514 (-17.1%) |
|  | tok/s/user p50 | 492 | 606 (+23.2%) | **616 (+25.2%)** | 585 (+18.9%) |
|  | Output tok/s | 1,519 | 1,733 (+14.1%) | **1,757 (+15.7%)** | 1,875 (+23.4%) |
|  | TTFT p50 (ms) | 712 | 715 (+0.4%) | **708 (-0.6%)** | 494 (-30.6%) |
| 8 | Decode step p50 (ms) | 8.473 | 7.755 (-8.5%) | **7.591 (-10.4%)** | 7.656 (-9.6%) |
|  | tok/s/user p50 | 355 | 381 (+7.3%) | **390 (+9.9%)** | 390 (+9.9%) |
|  | Output tok/s | 2,085 | 2,186 (+4.8%) | **2,227 (+6.8%)** | 2,444 (+17.2%) |
|  | TTFT p50 (ms) | 1,069 | 1,082 (+1.2%) | **1,066 (-0.3%)** | 769 (-28.1%) |

#44626 shortens the decode step by 8.5-19.4% against `main`. #44628 takes another 0.09-0.16 ms off (1.8-2.4%). #44627 leaves the decode step unchanged within round noise (-0.05 to +0.07 ms) and cuts TTFT by 23-30% with the prefill CUDA graph, which lifts output throughput at concurrency 8 from 2,227 to 2,444 tok/s. All three together: decode step -9.6% to -21.8%, tok/s/user +9.9% to +25.1%, output tok/s +17.2% to +28.0%.

The two-arm run under Speed Tests measured this PR's batch-1 gain at 0.18 ms (-4.3%); across the two launches it is 0.10-0.18 ms.

```mermaid
xychart-beta
    title "tok/s/user p50 (higher is better): bars = main; lines = + #44626, + #44628, + #44627"
    x-axis "Concurrency" ["1", "2", "4", "8"]
    y-axis "tok/s/user" 0 --> 900
    bar [724, 614, 492, 355]
    line [836, 754, 606, 381]
    line [864, 774, 616, 390]
    line [864, 768, 585, 390]
```

#44626 adds `--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode`, which moves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash's target-model decode on GB300 onto kernels sized for 1 to 48 rows. The DSpark draft and the verify accept still run their stock paths:

- **Draft layers.** The draft MoE runs FlashInfer's routed MoE with its own finalize, and the draft attention projections run the persistent MXFP8 GEMM, both sized for larger batches.
- **Markov head.** The draft proposal runs one Markov step kernel plus a vocabulary gather per draft position.
- **Sampled requests.** The verify accept writes full-vocabulary softmax rows for the target and the draft, runs a single-CTA rejection kernel, and broadcasts its decisions from rank 0. It runs eagerly after the verify graph.

Agentic serving (AgentX) samples at the server's default temperature, so the sampled accept is on every step.

## Modifications

Under the same switch, with no new flag (`python/sglang/srt/models/dsv41_low_latency/dspark/`, README section "DSpark draft and verify").

| Path | Replaces | Applies to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Draft attention `wq_b`, `wo_b` on the low-latency MXFP8 GEMM (same shapes and pinned tactics as the target) | the persistent CuTe DSL MXFP8 GEMM | 1-8 rows |
| Draft MoE on #44626's routed-expert GEMM pair plus a local finalize (`finalize.cu`, FlashInfer's small-batch finalize arithmetic) | FlashInfer TRT-LLM-gen routed MoE with `do_finalize=True` | 1-48 rows |
| The whole Markov chain in one vocab-sharded cooperative kernel per rank; ranks exchange one key per row and step through symmetric memory | a Markov step kernel + vocab gather per draft position | 1-8 requests |
| Temperature-sampling accept (rejection, bonus, accept-site sync, Engram and KV commits) captured in one CUDA graph per verify batch size and compiled at startup | the eager accept after the replay | all-sampled static verify steps |
| Block-wise rejection sampler: per-vocab-block stats, a one-warp accept, a block-parallel Gumbel-max resample, counter-based draws | target and draft softmax + single-CTA rejection kernel | no top-k / top-p, no block verification |
| Engram history commit recorded in the static verify graph, gated per row; draft context-KV projection on a side stream beside the accept | the eager commit after the replay; the projection after the accept | static verify graphs |

**Rank agreement without the accept broadcast.** The block-wise sampler's draws are functions of (server seed, a device step counter, row, token). Every rank therefore computes the same accept from the same logits, and the accept syncs at the `dspark-accept-greedy` site instead of `dspark-accept-sample`. With `SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=rng` it broadcasts nothing; with the default `all` it still does, so the variable's meaning is unchanged.

**Fallbacks and lockstep.**

- Mixed greedy / sampled batches, top-k, top-p, grammar and logit-adjusted steps take the eager accept.
- A cross-rank wait in the sharded Markov kernel traps after 20 s instead of hanging.
- Every per-step gate reads batch flags, shapes and which graphs were captured, all shared by the TP ranks.

**Outside the package** (+219 / −53 lines in 7 files):

- `dspark_worker_v2.py`: install, precompile and the graph-accept call.
- `dspark_draft_sampler.py`: the sharded-chain hook with the stock per-step fallback.
- `dspark_verify.py`: the rejection-noise field, the sync-site clause and the static-epilogue override; the package is imported lazily.
- `deepseek_v4_dspark.py`: `project_context_kv` and the install call.
- `engram_hash.py`: optional per-row gating of the history commit.
- `dspark_kv_inject.py`.
- `mxfp4_flashinfer_trtllm_moe.py`: the non-deferred finalize for the draft's pair.

With the switch off, every new field stays `None` and the stock calls run.

## Accuracy Tests

`sgl-eval run gsm8k --num-examples 200 --num-threads 64 --max-tokens 4096` (sgl-eval 0.1.2, the settings of `test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300.py`: greedy, no thinking), DSpark with real acceptance:

| arm | GSM8K-200 (sgl-eval) |
| --- | --- |
| #44626 only, switch on | 0.980 |
| this PR (#44626 + DSpark paths), switch on | 0.980 |

Error rate 0 and truncation 0 in both. Unit tests cover the block-wise sampler's joint law of accepted length and bonus token against the analytic speculative-sampling law (χ²).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Repro.** Same launch as #44626 with the switch on:

```bash
SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=rng \
SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.51 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token \
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --trust-remote-code \
  --tp 4 --ep-size 1 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8 --max-running-requests 16 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 \
  --enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode
```

The client is the same as in #44626: 8,192 random input tokens, 1,024 output tokens, closed loop at concurrency C, and the step is the median gap between streamed chunks. Rows marked T 1.0 send `temperature=1.0`; every other row is greedy.

**Decode step, same node, one server per launch** (switch on in both arms; #44626 = the target-side paths only). Each launch ran two rounds, the second in reverse concurrency order; the table shows the mean of the two. Rows marked T 1.0 are two more rounds at batch 1 with `temperature=1.0`.

| Batch (rows) | #44626 (ms) | this PR (ms) | Change |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 (6) | 4.136 | 3.960 | −4.3% |
| 2 (12) | 4.609 | 4.538 | −1.5% |
| 4 (24) | 5.586 | 5.496 | −1.6% |
| 8 (48) | 7.734 | 7.633 | −1.3% |
| 1, T 1.0 | 4.784 | 4.204 | −12.1% |

- At temperature 1.0 the gain comes mostly from the in-graph sampling accept and the block-wise sampler; greedy steps never run them.
- A torch-profiler window at batch 1 shows the draft paths running: the draft MoE moves from FlashInfer's routed MoE to the routed-expert pair (+87 route / GEMM launches per 30 steps, FlashInfer `bmm_` 254 → 80), the draft `wq_b` / `wo_b` run the low-latency MXFP8 GEMM, and the per-position Markov kernels are gone (one sharded-chain kernel per step).
- No serving-time compile and no error line in either arm.

Four more host and kernel changes (small-batch mHC coefficient GEMM, host-side Engram table with prefetch, captured attention metadata with leaner input preparation, 8-row compressor tile) are worth about 0.04 ms per step each on the newest `main` and are left out of these MRs.

## Tests

```bash
python3 -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_dsv41_draft_routed_expert_gemm.py \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_deepseek_v41_dspark_context_side_stream.py \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_deepseek_v41_dspark_sharded_markov_dispatch.py \
  test/registered/kernels/ops/speculative/test_dspark_sharded_markov.py \
  test/registered/unit/speculative/test_dspark_blockwise_rejection.py \
  test/registered/unit/speculative/test_dspark_engram_commit_in_graph.py \
  test/registered/unit/speculative/test_dspark_sampling_accept_graph.py
```

| Check | What it covers | Result (GB300) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Draft MoE pair + finalize | vs FlashInfer at 1 / 5 / 8 / 40 rows, eager and graph replay; the draft binding and the finalize decline | Passed |
| Sharded Markov chain | One rank and four ranks (spawned) bit-equal to the per-step loop; dispatch only with the switch on | Passed |
| Block-wise rejection | χ² law at T 1/1, 0.7/1.3 and a one-hot draft; counter determinism; graph and region replay; precompile; the sync site under `rng` and `all` | Passed |
| Sampling-accept graph | Eligibility, warm-up / capture / replay, fallbacks, parity with the eager accept | Passed |
| Engram commit in graph, context side stream | Live-row gating; commit reported only when captured; the store uses the precomputed KV | Passed |
| All #44626 + this PR's test files together | GB300 with GPU cases: 122 passed, 197 subtests, 1 skipped; the four-rank wo_b test 2 passed per rank. CPU on this head: 88 passed, 96 subtests, 0 failed | Passed |
| pre-commit | All hooks on every changed file | Passes |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+# DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash low-latency decode (GB300)
+
+`--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode` replaces a set of stock decode kernels of
+DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with kernels sized for 1 to 48 rows. It targets agentic
+serving, where a server decodes a handful of requests at a time with DSpark
+speculative decoding and users see the time per output token.
+
+With the switch off, nothing in this package runs and the model takes the stock
+paths.
+
+## Validated deployment
+
+The switch refuses every other deployment at startup, listing each requirement
+it misses (`switch.check_deployment`):
+
+- DeepSeek-V4.1, one SM103 node (GB300 / B300), `--tp-size 4`;
+- `--ep-size 1` and `--moe-a2a-backend none` (the routed-expert GEMMs serve
+  every expert locally);
+- no pipeline, DP-attention or context parallelism, no two-batch overlap;
+- `--speculative-algorithm DSPARK`, the default DeepSeek-V4 attention backend,
+  decode CUDA graphs;
+- no encoder or decoder SWA bounded replay, PD disaggregation, LoRA or
+  deterministic inference;
+- no `--enable-fp32-lm-head` or `--rl-on-policy-target` (the low-M LM head
+  returns BF16 logits).
+
+## Paths
+
+Each path replaces one stock call. It runs only inside its row bound
+(`switch.py`) and otherwise declines, so the stock kernel runs. Rows are the
+tokens of one forward: a DSpark verify step at batch `b` has `6 b` rows.
+
+| Path | Replaces | Rows | Module |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `wqkv_a`, `wq_b`, `wo_b` on FlashInfer's `cutedsl_low_latency` MXFP8 GEMM, tactics pinned per GB300 shape | the persistent CuTe DSL MXFP8 GEMM | 1-8 | `mxfp8_linear.py` |
+| `wo_b`'s epilogue stores its rows into the Lamport mailbox; the attention boundary runs only the all-reduce + mHC consumer | `wo_b` + the fused all-reduce + mHC post | 1-8 | `wo_b_publish.py`, `lamport/` |
+| Routed experts: one route kernel + two `tcgen05` GEMMs (8-row tiles; an expert chosen by more rows gets several tiles), NVRTC-compiled | FlashInfer TRT-LLM-gen routing + batched GEMMs | 1-48 | `routed_expert_gemm.py`, `routed_expert_gemm_src/` |
+| Compressor `wkv` / `wkv_gate`, indexer `weights_proj` and `wk` on split-K low-M BF16 GEMMs | cuBLAS and the JIT small GEMMs | 1-8 | `indexer.py`, `low_m_gemm.py`, `ll_bf16/` |
+| Indexer query (`weights_proj`, `wq_b`, RoPE + FP4 pack) on a side stream beside `wqkv_a` and the compressor | the same work on the sources stream | low-ratio decode | `indexer.py` |
+| LM head (shared with the DSpark draft) on FlashInfer's CuTe DSL low-M BF16 GEMM | cuBLAS split-K + reduce | 1-16 | `lm_head.py` |
+| Gluon swap-AB sparse decode attention up to 24 rows, launched with PDL, one-warp combine | FlashMLA sparse decode on 64 zero-padded heads past 8 rows | 6-24 | `switch.SWAPAB_MAX_ROWS` |
+
+## DSpark draft and verify
+
+The same switch moves the DSpark draft and the verify accept onto low-latency
+paths (`dspark/`). They take effect only when the target resolved the switch;
+there is no second flag.
+
+| Path | Replaces | Rows | Module |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| Draft attention `wq_b`, `wo_b` on the low-latency MXFP8 GEMM (same shapes and pinned tactics as the target) | the persistent CuTe DSL MXFP8 GEMM | 1-8 | `dspark/install.py`, `mxfp8_linear.py` |
+| Draft MoE on the routed-expert GEMM pair plus a local finalize (`finalize.cu`, FlashInfer's small-batch finalize arithmetic), since draft stages do not defer the finalize | FlashInfer TRT-LLM-gen routed MoE with `do_finalize=True` | 1-48 | `dspark/install.py`, `routed_expert_gemm.py` |
+| Whole Markov chain of the folded draft proposal in one vocab-sharded cooperative kernel per rank; ranks exchange one key per row and step through symmetric memory | one Markov step kernel + vocab gather per draft step | 1-8 requests | `dspark/sharded_markov.py`, `.cu` |
+| Draft context-KV projection on a side stream beside the accept, inside the verify CUDA graph | the same projection after the accept | static verify graphs | `dspark/static_epilogue.py` |
+| Engram history commit recorded in the verify CUDA graph, gated per row | the eager commit after the replay | static verify graphs | `dspark/static_epilogue.py` |
+| Temperature-sampling accept (rejection, bonus, accept-site sync, Engram and KV commits) in one CUDA graph per verify batch size, compiled at startup | the eager accept after the replay | all-sampled static steps | `dspark/sampling_accept_graph.py` |
+| Block-wise rejection sampler: per-vocab-block stats, a one-warp accept, a block-parallel Gumbel-max resample, counter-based draws | draft and target softmax + single-CTA rejection kernel | no top-k / top-p, no block verification | `dspark/blockwise_rejection.py` |
+
+The block-wise sampler's draws are functions of (server seed, a device step
+counter, row, token), so every rank computes the same accept from the same
+logits. Its accept syncs at the `dspark-accept-greedy` site instead of
+`dspark-accept-sample`: with `SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=rng` it broadcasts nothing,
+with the default `all` it still broadcasts. The sampling-accept graph serves
+all-sampled steps only; mixed greedy / sampled, top-k, top-p, grammar and
+logit-adjusted steps take the eager accept. A cross-rank wait
+in the sharded Markov kernel traps after 20 s (`sharded_markov.TIMEOUT_MS`)
+instead of hanging. Every per-step DSpark gate reads batch flags, shapes and
+which graphs were captured, all shared by the TP ranks; the sharded chain is
+built on every rank or on none (CPU all-reduce at startup).
+
+## Rank lockstep
+
+The fused all-reduce and the mailbox are collectives, so every rank must take the
+same path at every step. Each gate reads only host state that all TP ranks share:
+row counts, the graph mode and load-time facts. Nothing is read back from the GPU.
+A publish whose rows were not reduced by the fused post raises instead of
+desynchronizing the mailbox.
+
+## Startup
+
+The MXFP8 projections are tuned at 1, 2, 4 and 8 rows during FlashInfer's
+startup autotune, with the pinned tactic as the only choice for 5-8 rows; the
+autotune cache key records the switch. The routed-expert GEMMs are compiled with
+NVRTC on first use and cached under `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR/dsv41_routed_expert_gemm`.
+The mailbox and its publishing GEMM are built on the first eager forward, never
+during graph capture.
+
+## Provenance
+
+The routed-expert GEMMs, the wo_b publish, the Lamport all-reduce + mHC changes and the low-M projections were developed at NVIDIA for this model. Files derived from vLLM (vllm-project/vllm@75e3b17c) or FlashInfer keep those projects' SPDX and copyright headers.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""Block-wise rejection sampling of a DSpark verify chain.
+
+Developed at NVIDIA; classic chain verification only. It replaces the draft / target
+softmax writes and the single-CTA ``speculative_sampling_classic_kernel``:
+
+1. per-vocab-block target / draft max and sum-exp (rows x 8,192-token blocks), no
+   probability tensors;
+2. a one-warp accept per request that reads only those stats plus the draft token's
+   logits: accept iff ``log p(x) > log u + log q(x)``, i.e. ``u * q < p`` as before;
+3. a block-parallel Gumbel-max resample of the rejected row's residual
+   ``max(p - q, 0)`` (or of ``p`` at the bonus row), reduced by a one-program insert.
+
+The draws are counter-based: a request row's accept coins and its resample noise are
+functions of (server key, a device step counter, row, token). Every TP rank holds the
+same key, counter and logits, so ranks agree without a broadcast, and a CUDA graph
+replay advances the counter like an eager call. Distributions are those of the classic
+kernel; only the random stream differs. Top-k / top-p and block verification keep the
+classic kernel (`applies`).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+from triton.language.extra import libdevice
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.dispatch import inputs_on_cuda
+
+# XORed into the server seed so the rejection draws differ from other samplers'.
+_REJECTION_NOISE_DOMAIN = 0x5B1E3C7A9D2F4E61
+# Odd multiplier mixing the step counter into the per-step seed.
+_STEP_SEED_MULT = tl.constexpr(0x632BE59BD9B4E019)
+# Smallest positive fp32 value of tl.rand; coins stay in (0, 1).
+_TL_RAND_MIN = tl.constexpr(4.6566127342e-10)
+_STATS_BLOCK = 8192
+_RESAMPLE_BLOCK = 1024
+
+
+class RejectionNoise(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Key of the rejection draws, and a device step counter each call advances."""
+
+    key: int
+    counter: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def applies(
+    *, noise: Optional[RejectionNoise], sampling_info, block_verification: bool
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether a sampling accept takes this sampler (``noise`` is None without the
+    switch); host state every TP rank shares."""
+    return (
+        noise is not None
+        and not block_verification
+        and not sampling_info.need_top_k_sampling
+        and not sampling_info.need_top_p_sampling
+    )
+
+
+def accept(
+    *,
+    candidates: torch.Tensor,
+    target_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_block,
+    sampling_info,
+    noise: RejectionNoise,
+    verify_num_draft_tokens: int,
+    cutoff_verify_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    fused_argmax: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """accept_draft_tokens' sampling accept on this sampler; a mixed batch selects
+    the greedy accept for its greedy rows, as the classic path does."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.dspark_accept import (
+        AcceptGreedy,
+        SelectMixedAccept,
+    )
+
+    if sampling_info.is_any_greedy:
+        greedy_len, greedy_bonus, greedy_trim = AcceptGreedy.execute(
+            candidates=candidates,
+            target_logits=target_logits,
+            verify_num_draft_tokens=verify_num_draft_tokens,
+            cutoff_verify_lens=cutoff_verify_lens,
+            fused_argmax=fused_argmax,
+        )
+    sampled = BlockwiseRejection.execute(
+        candidates=candidates,
+        target_logits=target_logits,
+        draft_logits=None if draft_block.greedy_draft else draft_block.corrected_logits,
+        target_temperatures=sampling_info.temperatures,
+        draft_temperatures=draft_block.temperatures,
+        noise=noise,
+        cutoff_verify_lens=cutoff_verify_lens,
+    )
+    if not sampling_info.is_any_greedy:
+        return sampled
+    selected = SelectMixedAccept.execute(
+        greedy_mask=draft_block.greedy_mask,
+        greedy_len=greedy_len,
+        greedy_bonus=greedy_bonus,
+        greedy_trim=greedy_trim,
+        sampling_len=sampled[0],
+        sampling_bonus=sampled[1],
+        sampling_trim=sampled[2],
+    )
+    return selected.correct_len, selected.bonus, selected.cap_trim_lens
+
+
+def rejection_noise_key(random_seed: int) -> int:
+    return (int(random_seed) ^ _REJECTION_NOISE_DOMAIN) & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
+
+
+def make_rejection_noise(random_seed: int, device) -> RejectionNoise:
+    return RejectionNoise(
+        key=rejection_noise_key(random_seed),
+        counter=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _step_seed(key, counter_ptr):
+    return key + tl.load(counter_ptr) * _STEP_SEED_MULT
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rotl32(value, shift: tl.constexpr):
+    return (value << shift) | (value >> (32 - shift))
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _murmur3_mix(h, key):
+    key *= 0xCC9E2D51
+    key = _rotl32(key, 15)
+    key *= 0x1B873593
+    h ^= key
+    h = _rotl32(h, 13)
+    return h * 5 + 0xE6546B64
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _murmur3_uniform32(seed, pos, offset):
+    seed = seed.to(tl.int64)
+    pos = pos.to(tl.int64)
+    offset = offset.to(tl.uint32)
+    h = (seed ^ seed).to(tl.uint32)
+    h = _murmur3_mix(h, (seed & 0xFFFFFFFF).to(tl.uint32))
+    h = _murmur3_mix(h, ((seed >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF).to(tl.uint32))
+    h = _murmur3_mix(h, (pos & 0xFFFFFFFF).to(tl.uint32))
+    h = _murmur3_mix(h, offset)
+    h ^= 16
+    h ^= h >> 16
+    h *= 0x85EBCA6B
+    h ^= h >> 13
+    h *= 0xC2B2AE35
+    h ^= h >> 16
+    # Both 16-bit halves convert exactly: (h + 0.5) * 2**-32 keeps the u -> 0 tail.
+    hi16 = (h >> 16).to(tl.int32)
+    lo16 = (h & 0xFFFF).to(tl.int32)
+    return (
+        hi16.to(tl.float32) * 1.52587890625e-05
+        + (lo16.to(tl.float32) + 0.5) * 2.3283064365386963e-10
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _log1p_neg_stable(value):
+    # log(1 - value): series below 0.25 (abs error < 6e-7), direct above.
+    polynomial = 1.0 / 8.0
+    polynomial = 1.0 / 7.0 + value * polynomial
+    polynomial = 1.0 / 6.0 + value * polynomial
+    polynomial = 1.0 / 5.0 + value * polynomial
+    polynomial = 1.0 / 4.0 + value * polynomial
+    polynomial = 1.0 / 3.0 + value * polynomial
+    polynomial = 1.0 / 2.0 + value * polynomial
+    polynomial = 1.0 + value * polynomial
+    series = -value * polynomial
+    direct = tl.log(tl.maximum(1.0 - value, 5.960464477539063e-08))
+    return tl.where(value < 0.25, series, direct)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _global_lse(
+    max_ptr, sumexp_ptr, row, NUM_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr, PADDED: tl.constexpr
+):
+    blocks = tl.arange(0, PADDED)
+    mask = blocks < NUM_BLOCKS
+    maxes = tl.load(max_ptr + row * NUM_BLOCKS + blocks, mask=mask, other=float("-inf"))
+    sumexps = tl.load(sumexp_ptr + row * NUM_BLOCKS + blocks, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    global_max = tl.max(maxes, axis=0)
+    return global_max + tl.log(tl.sum(sumexps * tl.exp(maxes - global_max)))
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _stats_kernel(
+    t_max_ptr,
+    t_sumexp_ptr,
+    d_max_ptr,
+    d_sumexp_ptr,
+    target_logits_ptr,
+    target_stride,
+    draft_logits_ptr,
+    draft_stride_0,
+    draft_stride_1,
+    target_temp_ptr,
+    draft_temp_ptr,
+    target_vocab,
+    draft_vocab,
+    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    req = row // STRIDE
+    step = row % STRIDE
+    if step == STRIDE - 1:
+        # Bonus row: its resample reads raw logits, no stats.
+        return
+    block_idx = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs = block_idx * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    t_temp = tl.load(target_temp_ptr + req).to(tl.float32)
+    t = (
+        tl.load(
+            target_logits_ptr + row * target_stride + offs,
+            mask=offs < target_vocab,
+            other=float("-inf"),
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        / t_temp
+    )
+    t_max = tl.max(t, axis=0)
+    tl.store(t_max_ptr + row * NUM_BLOCKS + block_idx, t_max)
+    tl.store(
+        t_sumexp_ptr + row * NUM_BLOCKS + block_idx,
+        tl.where(t_max > float("-inf"), tl.sum(tl.exp(t - t_max)), 0.0),
+    )
+    if HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS:
+        d_temp = tl.load(draft_temp_ptr + req).to(tl.float32)
+        d = (
+            tl.load(
+                draft_logits_ptr + req * draft_stride_0 + step * draft_stride_1 + offs,
+                mask=offs < draft_vocab,
+                other=float("-inf"),
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            / d_temp
+        )
+        d_max = tl.max(d, axis=0)
+        tl.store(d_max_ptr + row * NUM_BLOCKS + block_idx, d_max)
+        tl.store(
+            d_sumexp_ptr + row * NUM_BLOCKS + block_idx,
+            tl.where(d_max > float("-inf"), tl.sum(tl.exp(d - d_max)), 0.0),
+        )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rejection_kernel(
+    correct_len_ptr,
+    raw_len_ptr,
+    trim_ptr,
+    rej_lse_ptr,
+    candidates_ptr,
+    candidates_stride,
+    verify_lens_ptr,
+    t_max_ptr,
+    t_sumexp_ptr,
+    d_max_ptr,
+    d_sumexp_ptr,
+    target_logits_ptr,
+    target_stride,
+    draft_logits_ptr,
+    draft_stride_0,
+    draft_stride_1,
+    target_temp_ptr,
+    draft_temp_ptr,
+    target_vocab,
+    draft_vocab,
+    bs,
+    key,
+    counter_ptr,
+    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+    PADDED_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_CUTOFF: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    seed = _step_seed(key, counter_ptr)
+    t_temp = tl.load(target_temp_ptr + req).to(tl.float32)
+    d_temp = 1.0
+    if HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS:
+        d_temp = tl.load(draft_temp_ptr + req).to(tl.float32)
+    num_correct = tl.zeros((), tl.int32)
+    verifying = True
+    for i in range(STRIDE - 1):
+        if verifying:
+            row = req * STRIDE + i
+            token = tl.load(candidates_ptr + req * candidates_stride + i + 1).to(
+                tl.int64
+            )
+            valid = (token >= 0) & (token < target_vocab)
+            token = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(token, 0), target_vocab - 1)
+            t_lse = _global_lse(t_max_ptr, t_sumexp_ptr, row, NUM_BLOCKS, PADDED_BLOCKS)
+            log_p = (
+                tl.load(target_logits_ptr + row * target_stride + token).to(tl.float32)
+                / t_temp
+                - t_lse
+            )
+            log_q = 0.0
+            if HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS:
+                d_lse = _global_lse(
+                    d_max_ptr, d_sumexp_ptr, row, NUM_BLOCKS, PADDED_BLOCKS
+                )
+                log_q = (
+                    tl.load(
+                        draft_logits_ptr
+                        + req * draft_stride_0
+                        + i * draft_stride_1
+                        + token,
+                        mask=token < draft_vocab,
+                        other=float("-inf"),
+                    ).to(tl.float32)
+                    / d_temp
+                    - d_lse
+                )
+            u = tl.maximum(tl.rand(seed, (req * STRIDE + i).to(tl.int32)), _TL_RAND_MIN)
+            # A proposal must have positive draft probability (classic kernel's guard).
+            ok = valid & (log_q > float("-inf")) & (log_p > tl.log(u) + log_q)
+            verifying = ok
+            num_correct += ok.to(tl.int32)
+    tl.store(raw_len_ptr + req, num_correct)
+    capped = num_correct
+    if HAS_CUTOFF:
+        cap = tl.load(verify_lens_ptr + req).to(tl.int32) - 1
+        capped = tl.minimum(num_correct, cap)
+    tl.store(correct_len_ptr + req, capped)
+    tl.store(trim_ptr + req, num_correct - capped)
+    t_lse_rej = 0.0
+    d_lse_rej = 0.0
+    if num_correct < STRIDE - 1:
+        rej_row = req * STRIDE + num_correct
+        t_lse_rej = _global_lse(
+            t_max_ptr, t_sumexp_ptr, rej_row, NUM_BLOCKS, PADDED_BLOCKS
+        )
+        if HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS:
+            d_lse_rej = _global_lse(
+                d_max_ptr, d_sumexp_ptr, rej_row, NUM_BLOCKS, PADDED_BLOCKS
+            )
+    tl.store(rej_lse_ptr + req, t_lse_rej)
+    tl.store(rej_lse_ptr + bs + req, d_lse_rej)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _resample_kernel(
+    res_max_ptr,
+    res_arg_ptr,
+    raw_len_ptr,
+    rej_lse_ptr,
+    candidates_ptr,
+    candidates_stride,
+    target_logits_ptr,
+    target_stride,
+    draft_logits_ptr,
+    draft_stride_0,
+    draft_stride_1,
+    target_temp_ptr,
+    draft_temp_ptr,
+    target_vocab,
+    draft_vocab,
+    bs,
+    key,
+    counter_ptr,
+    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    block_idx = tl.program_id(1)
+    seed = _step_seed(key, counter_ptr)
+    r = tl.load(raw_len_ptr + req).to(tl.int64)
+    row = req * STRIDE + r
+    is_bonus = r == STRIDE - 1
+    offs = block_idx * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < target_vocab
+    t_temp = tl.load(target_temp_ptr + req).to(tl.float32)
+    t = (
+        tl.load(
+            target_logits_ptr + row * target_stride + offs,
+            mask=mask,
+            other=float("-inf"),
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        / t_temp
+    )
+    if is_bonus:
+        residual = t
+    else:
+        rejected = tl.load(candidates_ptr + req * candidates_stride + r + 1)
+        if HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS:
+            d_temp = tl.load(draft_temp_ptr + req).to(tl.float32)
+            log_p = t - tl.load(rej_lse_ptr + req)
+            log_q = tl.load(
+                draft_logits_ptr + req * draft_stride_0 + r * draft_stride_1 + offs,
+                mask=offs < draft_vocab,
+                other=float("-inf"),
+            ).to(tl.float32) / d_temp - tl.load(rej_lse_ptr + bs + req)
+            # log max(p - q, 0) = log p + log1p(-q / p), -inf where q >= p.
+            ratio = tl.exp(log_q - log_p)
+            residual = tl.where(
+                ratio < 1.0, log_p + libdevice.log1p(-ratio), float("-inf")
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+        else:
+            # One-hot draft: the residual is p without the rejected token.
+            residual = tl.where(offs != rejected, t, float("-inf"))
+    u = _murmur3_uniform32(seed, req, offs)
+    noised = tl.where(mask, residual - tl.log(-_log1p_neg_stable(u)), float("-inf"))
+    value, idx = tl.max(noised, axis=0, return_indices=True)
+    tl.store(res_max_ptr + req * NUM_BLOCKS + block_idx, value)
+    tl.store(res_arg_ptr + req * NUM_BLOCKS + block_idx, block_idx * BLOCK + idx)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _insert_kernel(
+    bonus_ptr,
+    correct_len_ptr,
+    raw_len_ptr,
+    res_max_ptr,
+    res_arg_ptr,
+    candidates_ptr,
+    candidates_stride,
+    counter_ptr,
+    NUM_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+    PADDED_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    capped = tl.load(correct_len_ptr + req)
+    raw = tl.load(raw_len_ptr + req)
+    if capped < raw:
+        # Capped by the verify budget: the bonus is the correct draft after the cap.
+        bonus = tl.load(candidates_ptr + req * candidates_stride + capped + 1).to(
+            tl.int64
+        )
+    else:
+        blocks = tl.arange(0, PADDED_BLOCKS)
+        local_max = tl.load(
+            res_max_ptr + req * NUM_BLOCKS + blocks,
+            mask=blocks < NUM_BLOCKS,
+            other=float("-inf"),
+        )
+        # NaN would make argmax land in the padded tail.
+        local_max = tl.where(local_max != local_max, float("-inf"), local_max)
+        best = tl.argmax(local_max, axis=0)
+        bonus = tl.load(res_arg_ptr + req * NUM_BLOCKS + best)
+    tl.store(bonus_ptr + req, bonus)
+    if req == 0:
+        # The other kernels of this call have read the counter (stream order).
+        tl.store(counter_ptr, tl.load(counter_ptr) + 1)
+
+
+class BlockwiseRejection:
+    @classmethod
+    def execute(
+        cls, *args, **kwargs
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if inputs_on_cuda(*args, **kwargs):
+            return blockwise_rejection_triton(*args, **kwargs)
+        return blockwise_rejection_torch(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+def blockwise_rejection_triton(
+    *,
+    candidates: torch.Tensor,
+    target_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_logits: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    target_temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    noise: RejectionNoise,
+    cutoff_verify_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """``candidates`` [bs, S] (column 0 is the root), ``target_logits`` [bs * S, V],
+    ``draft_logits`` [>= bs, S - 1, V'] pre-temperature or None for a one-hot draft.
+    Returns (correct_len int32, bonus int64, cap_trim_lens int32), each [bs]."""
+    bs, stride = candidates.shape
+    target_vocab = target_logits.shape[-1]
+    assert target_logits.stride(-1) == 1 and target_logits.shape[0] == bs * stride
+    has_draft = draft_logits is not None
+    draft_vocab = draft_logits.shape[-1] if has_draft else target_vocab
+    if has_draft:
+        assert draft_logits.stride(-1) == 1 and draft_logits.shape[1] >= stride - 1
+    device = candidates.device
+    target_temperatures = target_temperatures.reshape(-1).contiguous()
+    draft_temperatures = draft_temperatures.reshape(-1).contiguous()
+    num_blocks = triton.cdiv(max(target_vocab, draft_vocab), _STATS_BLOCK)
+    padded_blocks = triton.next_power_of_2(num_blocks)
+    stats = torch.empty(
+        (4, bs * stride, num_blocks), dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+    )
+    lens = torch.empty((3, bs), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    rej_lse = torch.empty((2, bs), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    res_blocks = triton.cdiv(target_vocab, _RESAMPLE_BLOCK)
+    res_max = torch.empty((bs, res_blocks), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    res_arg = torch.empty((bs, res_blocks), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    bonus = torch.empty((bs,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    correct_len, raw_len, trim = lens[0], lens[1], lens[2]
+    t_max, t_sumexp, d_max, d_sumexp = stats[0], stats[1], stats[2], stats[3]
+    d_ptr = draft_logits if has_draft else target_logits
+    d_s0 = draft_logits.stride(0) if has_draft else 0
+    d_s1 = draft_logits.stride(1) if has_draft else 0
+    _stats_kernel[(bs * stride, num_blocks)](
+        t_max, t_sumexp, d_max, d_sumexp,
+        target_logits, target_logits.stride(0),
+        d_ptr, d_s0, d_s1,
+        target_temperatures, draft_temperatures,
+        target_vocab, draft_vocab,
+        STRIDE=stride, NUM_BLOCKS=num_blocks, BLOCK=_STATS_BLOCK,
+        HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS=has_draft,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    has_cutoff = cutoff_verify_lens is not None
+    verify_lens = (
+        cutoff_verify_lens.to(device=device).contiguous() if has_cutoff else correct_len
+    )
+    _rejection_kernel[(bs,)](
+        correct_len, raw_len, trim, rej_lse,
+        candidates, candidates.stride(0), verify_lens,
+        t_max, t_sumexp, d_max, d_sumexp,
+        target_logits, target_logits.stride(0),
+        d_ptr, d_s0, d_s1,
+        target_temperatures, draft_temperatures,
+        target_vocab, draft_vocab, bs,
+        noise.key, noise.counter,
+        STRIDE=stride, NUM_BLOCKS=num_blocks, PADDED_BLOCKS=padded_blocks,
+        HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS=has_draft, HAS_CUTOFF=has_cutoff,
+        num_warps=1,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    _resample_kernel[(bs, res_blocks)](
+        res_max, res_arg, raw_len, rej_lse,
+        candidates, candidates.stride(0),
+        target_logits, target_logits.stride(0),
+        d_ptr, d_s0, d_s1,
+        target_temperatures, draft_temperatures,
+        target_vocab, draft_vocab, bs,
+        noise.key, noise.counter,
+        STRIDE=stride, NUM_BLOCKS=res_blocks, BLOCK=_RESAMPLE_BLOCK,
+        HAS_DRAFT_LOGITS=has_draft,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    _insert_kernel[(bs,)](
+        bonus, correct_len, raw_len, res_max, res_arg,
+        candidates, candidates.stride(0), noise.counter,
+        NUM_BLOCKS=res_blocks, PADDED_BLOCKS=triton.next_power_of_2(res_blocks),
+        num_warps=1,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return correct_len, bonus, trim
+
+
+def blockwise_rejection_torch(
+    *,
+    candidates: torch.Tensor,
+    target_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_logits: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    target_temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    noise: RejectionNoise,
+    cutoff_verify_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Reference with the same math; draws from a generator seeded by (key, counter)."""
+    bs, stride = candidates.shape
+    gamma = stride - 1
+    vocab = target_logits.shape[-1]
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=candidates.device)
+    gen.manual_seed((noise.key + int(noise.counter.item()) * 1_000_003) % (2**63))
+    t_temp = target_temperatures.reshape(bs, 1, 1).float()
+    log_p = torch.log_softmax(
+        target_logits.float().view(bs, stride, vocab) / t_temp, -1
+    )
+    if draft_logits is not None:
+        d_temp = draft_temperatures.reshape(bs, 1, 1).float()
+        d = draft_logits[:bs, :gamma].float() / d_temp
+        log_q = torch.full((bs, gamma, vocab), float("-inf"), device=d.device)
+        log_q[..., : d.shape[-1]] = torch.log_softmax(d, -1)[..., :vocab]
+    else:
+        log_q = torch.full((bs, gamma, vocab), float("-inf"), device=log_p.device)
+        log_q.scatter_(-1, candidates[:, 1:].unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
+    coins = torch.rand((bs, gamma), generator=gen, device=candidates.device)
+    gumbel = -torch.log(
+        -torch.log(torch.rand((bs, vocab), generator=gen, device=candidates.device))
+    )
+    tokens = candidates[:, 1:].long()
+    lp = log_p[:, :gamma].gather(-1, tokens.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+    lq = log_q.gather(-1, tokens.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+    ok = (lq > float("-inf")) & (lp > torch.log(coins.clamp_min(4.6566127342e-10)) + lq)
+    raw = torch.cumprod(ok.int(), dim=-1).sum(-1).int()
+    rows = torch.arange(bs, device=candidates.device)
+    lp_rej = log_p[rows, raw.long()]
+    lq_rej = torch.cat([log_q, log_q[:, :1]], 1)[rows, raw.long()]
+    residual = torch.where(
+        raw.unsqueeze(-1) == gamma,
+        lp_rej,
+        torch.where(
+            lq_rej < lp_rej,
+            lp_rej + torch.log1p(-torch.exp(lq_rej - lp_rej)),
+            float("-inf"),
+        ),
+    )
+    bonus = (residual + gumbel).argmax(-1)
+    if cutoff_verify_lens is not None:
+        capped = torch.minimum(raw, cutoff_verify_lens.to(raw.device).int() - 1)
+    else:
+        capped = raw
+    capped_bonus = candidates.gather(
+        1, (capped.long() + 1).clamp_max(gamma).unsqueeze(-1)
+    ).squeeze(-1)
+    bonus = torch.where(capped < raw, capped_bonus, bonus)
+    noise.counter.add_(1)
+    return capped, bonus.long(), raw - capped

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""CUDA graphs of the temperature-sampling verify accept of static DSpark decode steps.
+
+The verify graph folds
+only the greedy accept (DsparkVerifyEpilogue). A sampling step ran the rest eagerly after
+the replay: the draft and target softmax (or the block-wise sampler), the rejection
+kernel, the bonus gather, the accept-site TP broadcast, the Engram history commit and the
+target-hidden KV commit (StaticEpilogue.run). This module captures that region once per verify-graph batch
+size and replays it right after the verify graph.
+
+The region reads the verify graph's static inputs and outputs (``static_io``) and the
+draft sampler's static buffers, which hold this step's values after both replays, so a
+replay stages nothing. Its accept outputs land in the epilogue's static accept buffers,
+like the greedy fold. Per key the first step runs eagerly (it compiles kernels and warms
+allocations), the second captures, later steps replay. The classic sampler's uniform
+draws come from torch's default generator, whose graph-safe offsets make a replay draw
+what the eager accept draws at the same generator state; the block-wise sampler's draws
+are counter-based. The accept-site broadcast stays in the region (pynccl inside the
+graph), so TP ranks agree as in the eager path.
+
+The caller routes only all-sampled steps without top-k / top-p, logit adjustments,
+grammar or a simulated sampled bonus; everything else keeps the eager accept.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from collections.abc import Callable, Hashable
+from functools import partial
+from typing import Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import graph_capture
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.dspark import blockwise_rejection
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.dspark.blockwise_rejection import (
+    RejectionNoise,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.dspark.static_epilogue import (
+    StaticEpilogue,
+    StaticVerifyIO,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_draft import DraftBlockResult
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_verify import (
+    AcceptOuts,
+    DsparkVerifyEpilogue,
+    accept_draft_tokens,
+    build_accept_outs,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_tp_sync import SpecTpSync, SpecTpSyncSite
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class GraphSamplingInfo(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """The SamplingBatchInfo fields the sampling accept reads, for an all-sampled
+    batch without top-k / top-p."""
+
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor
+    is_all_greedy: bool = False
+    is_any_greedy: bool = False
+    need_top_k_sampling: bool = False
+    need_top_p_sampling: bool = False
+
+
+def sampling_accept_commit_lens(
+    io: StaticVerifyIO,
+    *,
+    draft_sampler,
+    epilogue: DsparkVerifyEpilogue,
+    tp_sync: SpecTpSync,
+    fused_argmax: bool,
+    block_verification: bool,
+    rejection_noise: Optional[RejectionNoise],
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The eager sampling accept and finalize, on static buffers: same kernels, same
+    draws, same TP sync site; results go to the epilogue's accept buffers."""
+    bs, stride = io.candidates.shape
+    params = draft_sampler.params
+    draft_tokens = io.candidates[:, 1:]
+    draft_block = DraftBlockResult(
+        draft_tokens=draft_tokens,
+        corrected_logits=(
+            None if draft_sampler.greedy_draft else draft_sampler.step_logits[:bs]
+        ),
+        greedy_mask=params.greedy_mask[:bs],
+        temperatures=params.temperatures[:bs],
+        greedy_draft=draft_sampler.greedy_draft,
+    )
+    # params.temperatures is the batch's, clamped at 1e-5 (resolve_draft_params).
+    sampling_info = GraphSamplingInfo(temperatures=params.temperatures[:bs])
+    correct_len, bonus, cap_trim_lens = accept_draft_tokens(
+        candidates=io.candidates,
+        target_logits=io.logits,
+        draft_block=draft_block,
+        sampling_info=sampling_info,
+        draft_input=None,
+        gamma=stride - 1,
+        verify_num_draft_tokens=stride,
+        fused_argmax=fused_argmax,
+        block_verification=block_verification,
+        rejection_noise=rejection_noise,
+    )
+    return build_accept_outs(
+        correct_len=correct_len,
+        bonus=bonus,
+        cap_trim_lens=cap_trim_lens,
+        prefix_lens=io.seq_lens[:bs],
+        draft_tokens=draft_tokens.contiguous(),
+        gamma=stride - 1,
+        verify_num_draft_tokens=stride,
+        tp_sync=tp_sync,
+        # Counter-based draws agree across ranks, like a greedy accept.
+        sync_site=(
+            SpecTpSyncSite.DSPARK_ACCEPT_GREEDY
+            if blockwise_rejection.applies(
+                noise=rejection_noise,
+                sampling_info=sampling_info,
+                block_verification=block_verification,
+            )
+            else SpecTpSyncSite.DSPARK_ACCEPT_SAMPLE
+        ),
+        simulated_correct_len=epilogue.simulated_correct_len,
+        out=epilogue.read_accept(bs),
+    ).commit_lens
+
+
+class DsparkSamplingAcceptGraph:
+    """Per-batch-size CUDA graphs of the sampling accept region of static verify."""
+
+    # One key per verify-graph batch size is expected; more means addresses move,
+    # and the further keys run eagerly. Arbitrary bound.
+    MAX_GRAPHS = 32
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        epilogue: DsparkVerifyEpilogue,
+        static_epilogue: StaticEpilogue,
+        resolve_draft_sampler: Callable[[], Optional[object]],
+        tp_sync: SpecTpSync,
+        fused_argmax: bool,
+        block_verification: bool,
+        device,
+        rejection_noise: Optional[RejectionNoise] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._epilogue = epilogue
+        self._static = static_epilogue
+        self._resolve_draft_sampler = resolve_draft_sampler
+        self._tp_sync = tp_sync
+        self._fused_argmax = fused_argmax
+        self._block_verification = block_verification
+        self._rejection_noise = rejection_noise
+        # The region always commits; padded rows are gated by verify_lens.
+        self._gate = torch.ones((1,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self._graphs: dict[Hashable, torch.cuda.CUDAGraph] = {}
+        self._warmed_up: set[Hashable] = set()
+        self._pool = None
+        self.disabled = False
+        self.num_replays = 0
+
+    def run(self, *, bs: int, target_logits: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[AcceptOuts]:
+        """This step's accept through the region, or None when the step must take the
+        eager path. Reads only host state every TP rank holds identically."""
+        if self.disabled:
+            return None
+        draft_sampler = self._resolve_draft_sampler()
+        if draft_sampler is None or (
+            not draft_sampler.greedy_draft and draft_sampler.step_logits is None
+        ):
+            return None
+        graph_bs = min((b for b in self._static.static_io if b >= bs), default=None)
+        if graph_bs is None:
+            return None
+        io = self._static.static_io[graph_bs]
+        # The replayed verify graph must be the one whose buffers were recorded.
+        if target_logits.data_ptr() != io.logits.data_ptr():
+            return None
+        key = (
+            graph_bs,
+            io.logits.data_ptr(),
+            draft_sampler.params.temperatures.data_ptr(),
+            (
+                0
+                if draft_sampler.step_logits is None
+                else draft_sampler.step_logits.data_ptr()
+            ),
+        )
+        region = partial(
+            self._static.run,
+            io,
+            accept=partial(
+                sampling_accept_commit_lens,
+                draft_sampler=draft_sampler,
+                epilogue=self._epilogue,
+                tp_sync=self._tp_sync,
+                fused_argmax=self._fused_argmax,
+                block_verification=self._block_verification,
+                rejection_noise=self._rejection_noise,
+            ),
+            gate=self._gate,
+        )
+        self._run(key, region)
+        return self._epilogue.read_accept(bs)
+
+    def _run(self, key: Hashable, region: Callable[[], object]) -> None:
+        graph = self._graphs.get(key)
+        if graph is None:
+            if key not in self._warmed_up:
+                if len(self._warmed_up) < self.MAX_GRAPHS:
+                    self._warmed_up.add(key)
+                region()
+                return
+            graph = self._capture(key, region)
+            if graph is None:
+                return
+        graph.replay()
+        self.num_replays += 1
+
+    def _capture(
+        self, key: Hashable, region: Callable[[], object]
+    ) -> Optional[torch.cuda.CUDAGraph]:
+        if self._pool is None:
+            self._pool = torch.cuda.graph_pool_handle()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        try:
+            # graph_capture() enables pynccl, which the in-graph accept broadcast needs.
+            with (
+                graph_capture() as ctx,
+                torch.cuda.graph(
+                    graph,
+                    pool=self._pool,
+                    stream=ctx.stream,
+                    capture_error_mode="thread_local",
+                ),
+            ):
+                region()
+        except Exception:
+            logger.warning(
+                "DSpark sampling-accept graph capture failed for %s; sampling steps "
+                "take the eager accept from now on.",
+                key,
+                exc_info=True,
+            )
+            self.disabled = True
+            # A failed capture recorded the ops without running them.
+            region()
+            return None
+        logger.info("Captured the DSpark sampling-accept region for %s.", key)
+        self._graphs[key] = graph
+        return graph
+
+
+class _NoTpSync:
+    """Dummy inputs need no rank agreement, and warm-up must not issue collectives."""
+
+    def sync(self, site: SpecTpSyncSite, values: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return values
+
+
+_NO_TP_SYNC = _NoTpSync()
+
+
+def precompile_sampling_accept(
+    *,
+    capture_bs: list[int],
+    stride: int,
+    target_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_sampler,
+    fused_argmax: bool,
+    block_verification: bool,
+    rejection_noise: Optional[RejectionNoise] = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Run the eager sampling and mixed accepts once per decode batch size on dummy
+    inputs shaped like the served ones (vocab width and dtypes are kernel constants),
+    so serving never stalls on their JIT compiles."""
+    device = target_logits.device
+    vocab = target_logits.shape[-1]
+    step_logits = draft_sampler.step_logits
+    for bs in capture_bs:
+        candidates = torch.zeros((bs, stride), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        logits = torch.zeros(
+            (bs * stride, vocab), dtype=target_logits.dtype, device=device
+        )
+        temperatures = torch.ones((bs, 1), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        draft_block = DraftBlockResult(
+            draft_tokens=candidates[:, 1:],
+            corrected_logits=(
+                None
+                if draft_sampler.greedy_draft
+                else torch.zeros_like(step_logits[:bs])
+            ),
+            greedy_mask=torch.arange(bs, device=device) % 2 == 0,
+            temperatures=temperatures.view(-1),
+            greedy_draft=draft_sampler.greedy_draft,
+        )
+        for any_greedy in (False, True):
+            info = GraphSamplingInfo(
+                temperatures=temperatures, is_any_greedy=any_greedy
+            )
+            correct_len, bonus, cap_trim_lens = accept_draft_tokens(
+                candidates=candidates,
+                target_logits=logits,
+                draft_block=draft_block,
+                sampling_info=info,
+                draft_input=None,
+                gamma=stride - 1,
+                verify_num_draft_tokens=stride,
+                fused_argmax=fused_argmax,
+                block_verification=block_verification,
+                rejection_noise=rejection_noise,
+            )
+            build_accept_outs(
+                correct_len=correct_len,
+                bonus=bonus,
+                cap_trim_lens=cap_trim_lens,
+                prefix_lens=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
+                draft_tokens=candidates[:, 1:].contiguous(),
+                gamma=stride - 1,
+                verify_num_draft_tokens=stride,
+                tp_sync=_NO_TP_SYNC,
+                sync_site=SpecTpSyncSite.DSPARK_ACCEPT_SAMPLE,
+            )
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""DSpark Markov draft chain in one cooperative kernel per rank, vocab-sharded.
+
+Developed at NVIDIA; the CUDA kernel is unchanged. Rank k keeps rows [k V / world, (k +
+1) V / world) of the Markov head (markov_w2) in registers, adds the bias of the previous
+token's markov_w1 row to its shard of the base logits, picks its best (score, index) key
+and exchanges one 64-bit key per rank, request row and draft step through a mailbox in
+symmetric memory; the kept step logits reach every rank through peer staging. All draft
+steps run in one launch.
+
+SGLang glue: the Gumbel noise is SGLang's Philox draft noise (markov_sample.py, same key,
+counters and offset), drawn for this rank's shard before the chain; request rows map to
+themselves (temperature = the row's step temperature, 0 = argmax); a greedy draft keeps no
+step logits, so its rows are passed as inert (argmax, no cache write). `ShardedMarkovChain`
+binds it to the folded draft sampler (DsparkDraftSampler.markov_chain).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ctypes
+import logging
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+from triton.language.extra import libdevice
+
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.routed_expert_gemm import (
+    _check,
+    compile_source,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "sharded_markov.cu"
+SYMBOL = "dspark_sharded_markov_sample"
+RANK_DIM = 256
+THREADS = 512
+WARPS = THREADS // 32
+MAX_STEPS = 8
+MAX_RANKS = 8
+MAX_ROWS = 8  # MMA columns
+MAX_VOCAB = (1 << 17) - 1  # the candidate key's index field
+STAGING_OFFSET = 16384  # bytes; mailbox records come first
+CONTROL_WORDS = 256  # int32 words of per-instance control state
+ARRIVAL_WORDS = slice(128, 136)  # per-step arrival counters (sharded_markov.cu)
+NOISE_BLOCK = 1024
+NVRTC_OPTIONS = ("-std=c++17", "-default-device")
+# Bound on each cross-rank wait in the kernel: past it the kernel reports and traps
+# instead of hanging. Arbitrary; far above any step time.
+TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000
+_C_TYPES = {torch.bfloat16: "__nv_bfloat16", torch.float32: "float"}
+# markov_sample.py's Philox draft noise.
+_UNIFORM_SCALE = tl.constexpr(2.3283064365386963e-10)
+_PHILOX_ROUNDS = tl.constexpr(10)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _shard_noise_kernel(
+    NOISE,
+    OFFSET,
+    KEY,
+    VOCAB_START,
+    VOCAB_LOCAL,
+    STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Gumbel noise of (row, step) for this rank's vocab shard, as _select_block draws it."""
+    sample = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = sample // STEPS
+    step = sample % STEPS
+    part = tl.program_id(1)
+    quad = (part * BLOCK + VOCAB_START) // 4 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK // 4)
+    lane = tl.zeros([BLOCK // 4], tl.int64)
+    w0, w1, w2, w3 = tl.philox(
+        KEY,
+        quad.to(tl.uint32),
+        (lane + row).to(tl.uint32),
+        (lane + step).to(tl.uint32),
+        ((lane + tl.load(OFFSET)) & 0xFFFFFFFF).to(tl.uint32),
+        _PHILOX_ROUNDS,
+    )
+    bits = tl.interleave(tl.interleave(w0, w2), tl.interleave(w1, w3))
+    uniform = (bits.to(tl.float32) + 0.5) * _UNIFORM_SCALE
+    exp_noise = -libdevice.log1p(-uniform)
+    gumbel = -tl.log(exp_noise)
+    cols = part * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    tl.store(NOISE + sample * VOCAB_LOCAL + cols, gumbel, mask=cols < VOCAB_LOCAL)
+
+
+class _Kernel(NamedTuple):
+    function: object  # cuda.bindings.driver.CUfunction
+    max_ctas: int
+
+
+def _load_kernel(device, steps: int, base_dtype, cache_dtype) -> _Kernel:
+    from cuda.bindings import driver as cu
+
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)
+    defines = {
+        "STEPS": str(steps),
+        "BASE_T": _C_TYPES[base_dtype],
+        "CACHE_T": _C_TYPES[cache_dtype],
+    }
+    options = NVRTC_OPTIONS + tuple(
+        f"-D{name}={value}" for name, value in sorted(defines.items())
+    )
+    cubin = compile_source(
+        SOURCE.read_text(), SYMBOL, f"sm_{major}{minor}a", options=options
+    )

+"""The DSpark worker's low-latency verify paths: the block-wise rejection sampler, the
+static verify epilogue with the Engram and side-stream context-KV commits, and the
+sampling-accept graph with its startup precompile."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import time
+from typing import Callable, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.dspark.blockwise_rejection import (
+    RejectionNoise,
+    make_rejection_noise,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.dspark.sampling_accept_graph import (
+    DsparkSamplingAcceptGraph,
+    precompile_sampling_accept,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.dspark.static_epilogue import (
+    ContextKvSideStream,
+    StaticEpilogue,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.switch import ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_verify import (
+    AcceptOuts,
+    DsparkVerifyEpilogue,
+    TargetVerifyExecutor,
+    verify_logits_adjustments_are_noop,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_tp_sync import SpecTpSync
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DsparkLowLatency:
+    """Owned by the DSpark worker (DSparkWorkerV2.low_latency)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        static_epilogue: Optional[StaticEpilogue],
+        sampling_accept_graph: Optional[DsparkSamplingAcceptGraph],
+        resolve_draft_sampler: Callable[[], Optional[object]],
+        rejection_noise: RejectionNoise,
+        capture_bs: list[int],
+        stride: int,
+        block_verification: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._static = static_epilogue
+        self._sampling_accept_graph = sampling_accept_graph
+        self._resolve_draft_sampler = resolve_draft_sampler
+        self._rejection_noise = rejection_noise
+        self._capture_bs = sorted(capture_bs)
+        self._stride = stride
+        self._block_verification = block_verification
+
+    def sampling_accept(
+        self,
+        *,
+        bs: int,
+        target_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        proposal_folded: bool,
+        planner_mode: str,
+        sampling_info,
+        simulate_bonus_sampling_info,
+        has_grammar: bool,
+    ) -> Optional[AcceptOuts]:
+        """The accept of an all-sampled static step through the sampling-accept graph,
+        or None for the eager accept. Every gate reads host state all TP ranks share."""
+        if not (
+            self._sampling_accept_graph is not None
+            and proposal_folded
+            and planner_mode == "static"
+            and sampling_info is not None
+            and not sampling_info.is_any_greedy
+            and not sampling_info.need_top_k_sampling
+            and not sampling_info.need_top_p_sampling
+            and verify_logits_adjustments_are_noop(sampling_info)
+            and simulate_bonus_sampling_info is None
+            and not has_grammar
+        ):
+            return None
+        return self._sampling_accept_graph.run(bs=bs, target_logits=target_logits)
+
+    def committed_engram(
+        self, *, folded_accept: bool, run_compact: bool, graph_accept: bool
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Whether this step's Engram history commit ran inside a graph: the static
+        verify graph's folded accept, or the sampling-accept region (always commits)."""
+        return (
+            self._static is not None
+            and self._static.folds_engram_commit
+            and ((folded_accept and not run_compact) or graph_accept)
+        )
+
+    def precompile(self) -> None:
+        """Compile the sampling and mixed accept kernels for every decode batch size,
+        so the first temperature request does not stall on Triton compiles. Shapes come
+        from the captured verify and draft graphs, so this runs after both captures."""
+        static = self._static
+        sampler = self._resolve_draft_sampler()
+        if (
+            static is None
+            or not static.static_io
+            or sampler is None
+            or (not sampler.greedy_draft and sampler.step_logits is None)
+        ):
+            logger.warning(
+                "The DSpark sampling-accept precompile needs the static verify and "
+                "folded draft graphs; skipped."
+            )
+            return
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        precompile_sampling_accept(
+            capture_bs=self._capture_bs,
+            stride=self._stride,
+            target_logits=next(iter(static.static_io.values())).logits,
+            draft_sampler=sampler,
+            fused_argmax=static.fused_argmax,
+            block_verification=self._block_verification,
+            rejection_noise=self._rejection_noise,
+        )
+        logger.info(
+            "Precompiled the DSpark sampling accept for batch sizes %s in %.1f s.",
+            self._capture_bs,
+            time.perf_counter() - start,
+        )
+
+
+def _check_draft_graph_rows(*, capture_bs: list[int], rows_per_request: int) -> bool:
+    """Warn when the smallest draft CUDA graph has more rows than the draft's
+    routed-expert GEMMs take, so the draft MoE never runs on them."""
+    smallest = min(capture_bs) * rows_per_request if capture_bs else None
+    if smallest is None or smallest <= ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS:
+        return True
+    logger.warning(
+        f"The smallest DSpark draft CUDA graph has {smallest} rows ({rows_per_request} "
+        f"per request), above the {ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS} the draft routed-expert "
+        f"GEMMs take; add smaller decode CUDA graph batch sizes."
+    )
+    return False
+
+
+def install(
+    *,
+    executor: TargetVerifyExecutor,
+    epilogue: Optional[DsparkVerifyEpilogue],
+    draft_is_moe: bool,
+    resolve_engram_hasher: Callable[[], Optional[object]],
+    resolve_draft_sampler: Callable[[], Optional[object]],
+    tp_sync: SpecTpSync,
+    fused_argmax: bool,
+    random_seed: int,
+    device,
+    capture_bs: list[int],
+    rows_per_request: int,
+    stride: int,
+    block_verification: bool,
+) -> DsparkLowLatency:
+    """Called at the end of the DSpark worker's construction, on every rank."""
+    # Every rank holds the same seed, so the counter-based draws agree.
+    rejection_noise = make_rejection_noise(random_seed, device)
+    executor.rejection_noise = rejection_noise
+    _check_draft_graph_rows(capture_bs=capture_bs, rows_per_request=rows_per_request)
+    static_epilogue = sampling_accept_graph = None
+    if epilogue is not None:
+
+        def resolve_engram_history() -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+            hasher = resolve_engram_hasher()
+            return None if hasher is None else hasher.history
+
+        static_epilogue = StaticEpilogue(
+            epilogue=epilogue,
+            tp_sync=tp_sync,
+            fused_argmax=fused_argmax,
+            resolve_engram_history=resolve_engram_history,
+            context_kv_side_stream=ContextKvSideStream() if draft_is_moe else None,
+        )
+        epilogue.static_epilogue_override = static_epilogue
+        sampling_accept_graph = DsparkSamplingAcceptGraph(
+            epilogue=epilogue,
+            static_epilogue=static_epilogue,
+            resolve_draft_sampler=resolve_draft_sampler,
+            tp_sync=tp_sync,
+            fused_argmax=fused_argmax,
+            block_verification=block_verification,
+            device=device,
+            rejection_noise=rejection_noise,
+        )
+    return DsparkLowLatency(
+        static_epilogue=static_epilogue,
+        sampling_accept_graph=sampling_accept_graph,
+        resolve_draft_sampler=resolve_draft_sampler,
+        rejection_noise=rejection_noise,
+        capture_bs=capture_bs,
+        stride=stride,
+        block_verification=block_verification,
+    )

+"""Low-ratio layers at decode: the indexer query on its own side stream, and the
+compressor / indexer projections on low-M BF16 GEMMs."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.low_m_gemm import (
+    cutedsl_low_m_mm,
+    cutedsl_low_m_supported,
+    fits,
+    ll_bf16_supported,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.switch import LOW_M_BF16_MAX_ROWS
+
+
+def _ll_bf16_gemm(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.ll_bf16 import ll_bf16_gemm
+
+    return ll_bf16_gemm(x, weight)
+
+
+def _bf16_rounded(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    # FP32 accumulation rounded to the layer's BF16 output.
+    if not fits(x, LOW_M_BF16_MAX_ROWS):
+        return None
+    return _ll_bf16_gemm(x, weight).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _fp32(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    return _ll_bf16_gemm(x, weight) if fits(x, LOW_M_BF16_MAX_ROWS) else None
+
+
+def _bf16(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    return cutedsl_low_m_mm(x, weight) if fits(x, LOW_M_BF16_MAX_ROWS) else None
+
+
+def install_projections(attn: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """The compressor's ratio-1 wkv (BF16 out) and ratio-2 wkv_gate (FP32 out), the
+    indexer's weights_proj and wk: split-K GEMMs at 1-8 rows instead of cuBLAS or
+    the JIT small GEMMs, which give few output tiles to these skinny shapes."""
+    if not (ll_bf16_supported() and cutedsl_low_m_supported()):
+        return
+    if attn.compressor is not None:
+        attn.compressor.low_m_bf16_gemm = _bf16
+        attn.compressor.low_m_fp32_gemm = _fp32
+    if attn.indexer is not None:
+        attn.indexer.low_m_gemm = _bf16_rounded
+
+
+class IndexQ:
+    """One decode step's index query, built on a side stream beside wqkv_a, wq_b
+    and the compressor; the scoring on the sources stream waits for it."""
+
+    def __init__(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream, head_weights_raw: torch.Tensor):
+        self.stream = stream
+        self._head_weights_raw = head_weights_raw
+
+    def finish(
+        self,
+        *,
+        layer: nn.Module,
+        q_lora: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        forward_batch,
+        attn_backend,
+        stream_sources: torch.cuda.Stream,
+    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        self.stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.stream):
+            q, _ = layer.indexer.wq_b(q_lora)
+            prepared = attn_backend.low_ratio_decode_index_q(
+                layer=layer,
+                q=q,
+                head_weights_raw=self._head_weights_raw,
+                positions=positions,
+                forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            )
+        stream_sources.wait_stream(self.stream)
+        return prepared
+
+
+class IndexQSideStream:
+    def __init__(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream):
+        self._stream = stream
+
+    def begin(
+        self, layer: nn.Module, x: torch.Tensor, attn_backend
+    ) -> Optional[IndexQ]:
+        """Start weights_proj, which reads only x; None keeps the stock order."""
+        if layer.indexer is None or not attn_backend.low_ratio_decode_reads_prepared_q:
+            return None
+        self._stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self._stream):
+            head_weights_raw = layer.indexer.head_weights_raw(x)
+        return IndexQ(self._stream, head_weights_raw)
+
+
+def install_index_q_side_stream(attn: nn.Module) -> None:
+    if attn.indexer is not None and attn.alt_streams is not None:
+        # The low-ratio prepare leaves this one of the layer's three streams idle.
+        attn.low_latency_index_q = IndexQSideStream(attn.alt_streams[1])

+def install_decoder_layers(model: nn.Module) -> None:

+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.mxfp4_flashinfer_trtllm_moe import (
+        Mxfp4FlashinferTrtllmMoEMethod,

+    from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v2 import DeepseekV2MoE
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.routed_expert_gemm import build
+
+    for i in range(model.start_layer, model.end_layer):
+        layer = model.layers[i]
+        attn = layer.self_attn
+        projections = (attn.wqkv_a,) if attn.fuse_wqa_wkv else ()
+        mxfp8_linear.install(projections + (attn.wq_b, attn.wo_b))
+        indexer.install_projections(attn)
+        indexer.install_index_q_side_stream(attn)

+        model.start_layer,

+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import lm_head as low_latency_lm_head
+

+FlashInfer's LL kernels, copied: a publish kernel (or its MoE finalize
+variant) multicasts each rank's contribution into a three-generation Lamport
+mailbox, and a PDL-chained consumer spins until every rank's fragment lands,
+reduces it and normalizes. The consumer's residual add and copy are replaced by
+the mHC post-mix of the hc residual streams and their pre-mix collapse, which
+the RMSNorm then normalizes. The finalize variant also reads FP32 routing
+weights.

+Optionally the consumer also writes the normalized output as MXFP8 with UE8M0
+scales in the swizzled 128x4 layout FlashInfer's MXFP8 GEMMs read. It quantizes

+@cute.jit
+def _group_leader_block_sum(
+    value: Float32,
+    warp_sums: cute.Tensor,
+    warps: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    leader_stride: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+) -> Float32:
+    lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+    warp = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+    for offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, WARP_SIZE):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(offset >= leader_stride and (offset & (offset - 1)) == 0):
+            value = value + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                value,
+                offset=offset,
+                mask=-1,
+                mask_and_clamp=31,
+            )
+    if lane == 0:
+        cute.arch.store((warp_sums + warp).llvm_ptr, value)
+    cute.arch.barrier()
+
+    result = Float32(0.0)
+    if warp == 0:
+        if lane < Int32(warps):
+            result = cute.arch.load(
+                (warp_sums + lane).llvm_ptr,
+                Float32,
+            )
+        result = cute.arch.warp_reduction_sum(result)
+        if lane == 0:
+            cute.arch.store(warp_sums.llvm_ptr, result)
+    cute.arch.barrier()
+    return cute.arch.load(warp_sums.llvm_ptr, Float32)

+class _SharedOnlyPublishDeviceKernel:
+    def __init__(

+        *,

+        elements_per_thread: int,
+        threads: int,
+        release_before_store: bool,
+        enable_pdl: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        if elements_per_thread not in (1, QUAD_BF16, VEC_BF16):
+            raise ValueError("elements_per_thread must be 1, 4, or 8")
+        if hidden <= 0 or hidden % elements_per_thread:
+            raise ValueError("hidden must divide evenly across thread fragments")
+        self.hidden = hidden
+        self.tp = tp
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.capacity_m = capacity_m
+        self.elements_per_thread = elements_per_thread
+        self.threads = threads
+        self.fragments = hidden // elements_per_thread
+        self.ctas_per_token = math.ceil(self.fragments / threads)
+        self.release_before_store = release_before_store
+        self.enable_pdl = enable_pdl
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        shared_output: cute.Tensor,
+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        contribution_mailbox_multicast_address: Int64,
+        m: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.kernel(
+            shared_output,
+            stage_state,
+            contribution_mailbox_multicast_address,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(m * self.ctas_per_token, 1, 1),
+            block=(self.threads, 1, 1),
+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=self.enable_pdl,

+    @cute.kernel

+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        contribution_mailbox_multicast_address: Int64,
+    ) -> None:

+        cta_in_token = block % self.ctas_per_token

+
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.enable_pdl):

+class _QuadFinalizePublishDeviceKernel:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        hidden: int,
+        top_k: int,
+        tp: int,
+        rank: int,
+        capacity_m: int,
+        threads: int,
+        routed_scaling_factor: float,
+        include_shared_expert: bool,
+        load_shared_expert_before_pdl: bool,
+        enable_pdl: bool,
+        prefetch_group: int,
+        fp32_weights: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        if hidden <= 0 or hidden % QUAD_BF16:
+            raise ValueError("hidden must be a positive multiple of 4")
+        self.hidden = hidden
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.tp = tp
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.capacity_m = capacity_m
+        self.threads = threads
+        self.routed_scaling_factor = routed_scaling_factor
+        self.fragments = hidden // QUAD_BF16
+        self.ctas_per_token = math.ceil(self.fragments / threads)
+        self.include_shared_expert = include_shared_expert
+        self.load_shared_expert_before_pdl = load_shared_expert_before_pdl
+        self.enable_pdl = enable_pdl
+        self.prefetch_group = prefetch_group
+        self.prefetch_groups = (top_k + prefetch_group - 1) // prefetch_group
+        self.fp32_weights = fp32_weights
+
+    def smem_size_in_bytes(self) -> int:
+        return self.top_k * 8
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        routed_output: cute.Tensor,
+        expert_weights: cute.Tensor,
+        permuted_indices: cute.Tensor,
+        shared_output: cute.Tensor,
+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        contribution_mailbox_multicast_address: Int64,
+        m: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.kernel(
+            routed_output,
+            expert_weights,
+            permuted_indices,
+            shared_output,
+            stage_state,
+            contribution_mailbox_multicast_address,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(m * self.ctas_per_token, 1, 1),
+            block=(self.threads, 1, 1),

+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=self.enable_pdl,

+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        routed_output: cute.Tensor,
+        expert_weights: cute.Tensor,
+        permuted_indices: cute.Tensor,
+        shared_output: cute.Tensor,
+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        contribution_mailbox_multicast_address: Int64,
+    ) -> None:
+        block, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        token = block // self.ctas_per_token
+        cta_in_token = block % self.ctas_per_token
+        fragment = cta_in_token * self.threads + tidx
+
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        staged_indices = smem.allocate_array(Int32, self.top_k)
+        staged_weights = smem.allocate_array(Float32, self.top_k)
+        metadata_index = Int32(tidx)
+        while metadata_index < Int32(self.top_k):
+            element = Int64(token) * self.top_k + Int64(metadata_index)
+            row = cute.arch.load(
+                (permuted_indices.iterator + element).llvm_ptr,
+                Int32,
+            )
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.fp32_weights):
+                weight = cute.arch.load(
+                    (expert_weights.iterator + element).llvm_ptr,
+                    Float32,
+                )
+            else:
+                weight = load_global_bf16_as_f32(
+                    Int64((expert_weights.iterator + element).toint())
+                )

+                weight = weight * Float32(self.routed_scaling_factor)
+            if row == Int32(-1):
+                weight = Float32(0.0)
+            cute.arch.store(
+                (staged_indices + metadata_index).llvm_ptr,
+                row,
+            )
+            cute.arch.store(
+                (staged_weights + metadata_index).llvm_ptr,
+                weight,
+            )
+            metadata_index = metadata_index + self.threads
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.include_shared_expert):
+            shared_values = cute.make_rmem_tensor(
+                cute.make_layout((QUAD_BF16,)), BFloat16
+            )
+            shared_values.fill(BFloat16(0.0))

+                        Int64(token) * self.hidden + Int64(fragment) * QUAD_BF16
+                    )

+                        BFloat16,
+                        (shared_output.iterator + shared_element).llvm_ptr,
+                        cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                        assumed_align=8,
+                    )
+                    shared_values.store(
+                        packed_u32x2_to_bf16x4(load_global_u32x2(shared_pointer))
+                    )

+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+
