+        grid_m, grid_n = cute.ceil_div(mC.shape, tiler_mn)
+        self.kernel(
+            mA,
+            mB,
+            mC,
+            scale,
+            sA_layout,
+            sB_layout,
+            tiled_copy_A,
+            tiled_copy_B,
+            tiled_mma,
+            SharedStorage,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=[
+                cute.size(grid_m),
+                cute.size(grid_n),
+                self.split_k,
+            ],
+            block=[self.num_threads, 1, 1],
+            cluster=[
+                1,
+                1,
+                self.split_k,
+            ],  # split-K CTAs form one cluster
+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=self.use_pdl,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mA,
+        mB,
+        mC,
+        scale: cutlass.Float32,
+        sA_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sB_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tiled_copy_A: cute.TiledCopy,
+        tiled_copy_B: cute.TiledCopy,
+        tiled_mma: cute.TiledMma,
+        shared_storage: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ):
+        bM, bN, bK = self.tile_m, self.tile_n, self.tile_k
+        num_stages = self.num_stages
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        bid_m, bid_n, bid_z = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+        lane_id = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        num_dma_warps: cutlass.Constexpr = self.num_dma_warps
+        is_dma_warp = warp_idx < num_dma_warps
+        dma_tidx = tidx
+        mma_tidx = tidx - self.num_dma_threads
+        mma_warp_idx = warp_idx - num_dma_warps
+
+        cta_tiler = (bM, bN, bK)
+        coord = (bid_m, bid_n, None)  # all K tiles
+        # CTA-local tiles.
+        gA = cute.local_tile(
+            mA, tiler=cta_tiler, coord=coord, proj=(1, None, 1)
+        )  # skip N
+        gB = cute.local_tile(
+            mB, tiler=cta_tiler, coord=coord, proj=(None, 1, 1)
+        )  # skip M
+        gC = cute.local_tile(
+            mC, tiler=cta_tiler, coord=coord, proj=(1, 1, None)
+        )  # skip K
+
+        mcA = cute.make_identity_tensor(mA.layout.shape)
+        mcB = cute.make_identity_tensor(mB.layout.shape)
+        mcC = cute.make_identity_tensor(mC.layout.shape)
+        # Coordinate modes: cA=(M,K,k_tile), cB=(N,K,k_tile), cC=(M,N).
+        cA = cute.local_tile(mcA, tiler=cta_tiler, coord=coord, proj=(1, None, 1))
+        cB = cute.local_tile(mcB, tiler=cta_tiler, coord=coord, proj=(None, 1, 1))
+        cC = cute.local_tile(mcC, tiler=cta_tiler, coord=coord, proj=(1, 1, None))
+
+        # 128-bit cp.async copies require 16-byte aligned GMEM views.
+        gA = cute.make_tensor(gA.iterator.align(16), gA.layout)
+        gB = cute.make_tensor(gB.iterator.align(16), gB.layout)
+
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        storage_ptr = smem.allocate(shared_storage.size_in_bytes(), byte_alignment=16)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        storage = shared_storage(storage_ptr)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+        sA = storage.a.get_tensor(sA_layout)
+        sB = storage.b.get_tensor(sB_layout)
+
+        # Pipeline cp.async producers into MMA consumers.
+        producer_group = pipeline.CooperativeGroup(
+            pipeline.Agent.Thread, self.num_dma_threads
+        )
+        consumer_group = pipeline.CooperativeGroup(
+            pipeline.Agent.Thread, self.num_mma_threads
+        )
+        mainloop_pipeline = pipeline.PipelineCpAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar.data_ptr(),

+            producer_group=producer_group,
+            consumer_group=consumer_group,
+        )
+
+        # Round-robin split-K: split z handles tiles z, z+split_k, ...
+        K_total = cute.size(mA, mode=[1])
+        k_tile_count = cute.size(gA, mode=[2])
+        k_start = bid_z
+        num_k_tiles = cute.ceil_div(k_tile_count - k_start, self.split_k)
+
+        if is_dma_warp:
+            # DMA warps trade registers for copy throughput.
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(40)
+            thr_A = tiled_copy_A.get_slice(dma_tidx)
+            thr_B = tiled_copy_B.get_slice(dma_tidx)
+            tAgA = thr_A.partition_S(gA)
+            tAsA = thr_A.partition_D(sA)
+            tBgB = thr_B.partition_S(gB)
+            tBsB = thr_B.partition_D(sB)
+            tAcA = thr_A.partition_S(cA)
+            tBcB = thr_B.partition_S(cB)
+
+            # Build M/K and N/K predicates, broadcast across K-tile copies.
+            tApA_flat, tApA = self._make_pred(tAcA, k_start, mA.shape[0], K_total)
+            tBpB_flat, tBpB = self._make_pred(tBcB, k_start, mB.shape[0], K_total)
+            self._fill_pred(tApA_flat, tAcA, k_start, mA.shape[0], K_total)
+            self._fill_pred(tBpB_flat, tBcB, k_start, mB.shape[0], K_total)
+
+            producer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(
+                pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer, num_stages
+            )
+
+            # Prime the first pipeline stage.
+            mainloop_pipeline.producer_acquire(producer_state)
+            cute.copy(
+                tiled_copy_B,
+                tBgB[None, None, None, k_start],
+                tBsB[None, None, None, producer_state.index],
+                pred=tBpB,
+            )
+            if const_expr(self.use_pdl):
+                cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            cute.copy(
+                tiled_copy_A,
+                tAgA[None, None, None, k_start],
+                tAsA[None, None, None, producer_state.index],
+                pred=tApA,
+            )
+            mainloop_pipeline.producer_commit(producer_state)
+            producer_state.advance()

+            for k_tile in cutlass.range(
+                k_start + self.split_k, k_tile_count, self.split_k, unroll=1
+            ):
+                self._fill_pred(tApA_flat, tAcA, k_tile, mA.shape[0], K_total)
+                self._fill_pred(tBpB_flat, tBcB, k_tile, mB.shape[0], K_total)
+                mainloop_pipeline.producer_acquire(producer_state)
+                cute.copy(
+                    tiled_copy_A,
+                    tAgA[None, None, None, k_tile],
+                    tAsA[None, None, None, producer_state.index],
+                    pred=tApA,
+                )
+                cute.copy(
+                    tiled_copy_B,
+                    tBgB[None, None, None, k_tile],
+                    tBsB[None, None, None, producer_state.index],

+        else:

+                cute.nvgpu.warp.LdMatrix8x8x16bOp(False, 4), mB.element_type

+            thr_s2r_B = tiled_s2r_B.get_slice(lane_id)

+            tCrA_v = thr_s2r_A.retile(tCrA)
+            tCsB_v = thr_s2r_B.partition_S(sB)
+            tCrB_v = thr_s2r_B.retile(tCrB)

+            tCsA_warp_v = cute.logical_divide(tCsA_v, (None, None, num_mma_warps, None))
+            tCsB_warp_v = cute.logical_divide(tCsB_v, (None, None, num_mma_warps, None))

+            num_k_blocks = cute.size(tCrA, mode=[2])

+                pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, num_stages
+            )

+                        tiled_s2r_B,
+                        tCsB_warp_v[

+                        ],
+                        tCrB_v[None, None, 0],

+                        tiled_mma, tCrC, tCrA[None, None, 0], tCrB[None, None, 0], tCrC

+                consumer_state.advance()

+            # Cluster reduction epilogue.
+            # Reduce per-warp accumulators within this CTA.
+            num_elems: cutlass.Constexpr = self.num_epilogue_elems
+            elems_per_thread: cutlass.Constexpr = self.epilogue_elems_per_thread
+            # Map MMA threads to linear CTA output elements.

+                stride=(self.num_mma_threads, 1),

+                cute.arch.alloc_smem(
+                    cutlass.Float32, num_elems * num_mma_warps, alignment=16
+                ),
+                cute.make_layout((num_mma_warps, num_elems), stride=(num_elems, 1)),
+            )
+            smem_warp = cute.make_tensor(
+                cute.domain_offset((mma_warp_idx, 0), smem_red).iterator,
+                cute.make_layout((bM, bN), stride=(bN, 1)),
+            )
+            tCsC_partial = thr_mma.partition_C(smem_warp)
+            cute.autovec_copy(tCrC, tCsC_partial)

+            partials = cute.make_tensor(
+                cute.arch.alloc_smem(
+                    cutlass.Float32, num_elems * self.split_k, alignment=16

+                cute.make_layout((self.split_k, num_elems), stride=(num_elems, 1)),

+            for ei in cutlass.range_constexpr(elems_per_thread):
+                elem_idx = epilogue_slots[ei, mma_tidx]

+                            init_val=cutlass.Float32(0.0),

+            for ei in cutlass.range_constexpr(elems_per_thread):

+                local_coord = cute.select(epilogue_slot_coords[elem_idx], mode=[1, 0])
+                global_coord = cC[local_coord]

+                        partials[None, elem_idx]
+                        .load()
+                        .reduce(
+                            cute.ReductionOp.ADD,
+                            init_val=cutlass.Float32(0.0),
+                            reduction_profile=0,
+                        )
+                    )

+"""The DeepSeek-V4.1 LM head (shared with the DSpark draft) on FlashInfer's CuTe DSL
+low-M BF16 GEMM for 1-16 rows instead of cuBLAS split-K plus its reduce: about 48 us
+against 55 us on the TP4 shard (N = 32320, K = 5120) at 6 rows. Same BF16 output; only
+the K summation order differs."""

+import logging
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn

+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.unquant import UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.low_m_gemm import (
+    cutedsl_low_m_mm,
+    cutedsl_low_m_supported,
+    fits,

+# One call per FlashInfer token bucket (powers of two) tunes 1-16 rows.
+_TUNING_ROWS = tuple(1 << i for i in range(LM_HEAD_MAX_ROWS.bit_length()))
+
+
+class LowLatencyLmHeadMethod(UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod):
+    def apply(
+        self, layer: nn.Module, x: torch.Tensor, bias: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if bias is None and fits(x, LM_HEAD_MAX_ROWS):
+            return cutedsl_low_m_mm(x, layer.weight)
+        return super().apply(layer, x.to(layer.weight.dtype), bias)
+
+
+def install(lm_head: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Route an unquantized BF16 head's logits through `LowLatencyLmHeadMethod`."""
+    if not (
+        type(lm_head.quant_method) is UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod
+        and lm_head.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and cutedsl_low_m_supported()
+    ):
+        logger.warning(
+            "DSV4.1 low-latency LM head not installed: needs an unquantized BF16 "
+            "head and FlashInfer's CuTe DSL mm_bf16."
+        )
+        return
+    lm_head.quant_method = LowLatencyLmHeadMethod()
+
+
+def autotune(lm_head: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Inside the FlashInfer autotune context: the same calls on every rank."""
+    if not isinstance(lm_head.quant_method, LowLatencyLmHeadMethod):
+        return
+    weight = lm_head.weight
+    for rows in _TUNING_ROWS:
+        x = torch.zeros(
+            (rows, weight.shape[1]), dtype=weight.dtype, device=weight.device
+        )
+        cutedsl_low_m_mm(x, weight)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""BF16 GEMMs for 1-16 rows on SM100-family GPUs: FlashInfer's CuTe DSL ``mm_bf16``
+low-M kernels (BF16 out) and the split-K ``ll_bf16`` kernels (FP32 out)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+import torch
+
+_CUTEDSL_BACKEND = "cute-dsl"
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def cutedsl_low_m_supported() -> bool:
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return False
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    if major != 10:
+        return False
+    try:
+        from flashinfer import mm_bf16
+
+        return bool(mm_bf16.is_backend_supported(_CUTEDSL_BACKEND, major * 10 + minor))
+    except ImportError:
+        return False
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def _use_pdl() -> bool:
+    from sglang.kernels.jit.utils.arch import is_arch_support_pdl
+
+    return is_arch_support_pdl()
+
+
+def cutedsl_low_m_mm(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """BF16 ``x @ weight.T``; the caller checks rows, dtype and contiguity."""
+    from flashinfer import mm_bf16
+
+    # CuTe DSL takes operands over DLPack, which refuses tensors that require grad.
+    return mm_bf16(
+        x.detach(), weight.detach().t(), pdl=_use_pdl(), backend=_CUTEDSL_BACKEND
+    )
+
+
+def fits(x: torch.Tensor, max_rows: int) -> bool:
+    return (
+        0 < x.shape[0] <= max_rows
+        and x.dim() == 2
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and x.is_contiguous()
+    )
+
+
+def ll_bf16_supported() -> bool:
+    from sglang.srt.batch_invariant_ops import is_batch_invariant_mode_enabled
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import ll_bf16
+
+    return ll_bf16.is_available() and not is_batch_invariant_mode_enabled()

+"""The attention projections (wqkv_a, wq_b, wo_b) at 1-8 rows on FlashInfer's
+``cutedsl_low_latency`` MXFP8 GEMM instead of the persistent CuTe DSL kernel, with
+the tactic pinned per GB300 shape."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import importlib
+import logging
+from functools import lru_cache
+from typing import Iterator, Optional
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8LinearMethod
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.switch import MXFP8_MAX_ROWS
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+BACKEND = "cutedsl_low_latency"
+_GEMM_MODULE = "flashinfer.gemm.kernels.cute_dsl.low_latency_blockscaled_gemm"
+# (cta_k, ab_stages, sfb_tmem_stages, split_k) per (SM, N, K) for 5-8 rows: the TP4
+# wqkv_a, wq_b and wo_b of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on GB300, picked jointly in a 40-layer
+# chain. FlashInfer tunes 5-8 rows as its bucket 8.
+PINNED_TACTICS: dict[tuple[int, int, int], tuple[int, int, int, int]] = {
+    (103, 1792, 5120): (128, 10, 1, 4),
+    (103, 8192, 1280): (256, 6, 1, 1),
+    (103, 5120, 2048): (256, 4, 1, 2),
+}
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def supported() -> bool:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import _raw_flashinfer_mm_mxfp8
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_platform
+
+    try:
+        return bool(
+            _raw_flashinfer_mm_mxfp8.is_backend_supported(
+                BACKEND, get_platform().device_sm
+            )
+        )
+    except (AttributeError, ImportError, RuntimeError):
+        return False
+
+
+def _linear(
+    layer: nn.Module, x, weight_scale: torch.Tensor, bias
+) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import (
+        flashinfer_mxfp8_blockscaled_linear,
+    )
+
+    data = x[0] if isinstance(x, tuple) else x
+    rows = data.numel() // data.shape[-1]
+    if not (
+        0 < rows <= MXFP8_MAX_ROWS
+        and data.shape[-1] % 128 == 0
+        and data.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        return None
+    return flashinfer_mxfp8_blockscaled_linear(
+        input=data,
+        weight=layer.weight,
+        weight_scale=weight_scale.reshape(-1),
+        input_scale=x[1].reshape(-1) if isinstance(x, tuple) else None,
+        bias=bias,
+        backend=BACKEND,
+    )
+
+
+def install(linears: tuple[nn.Module, ...]) -> None:
+    """Route each MXFP8 linear's 1-8-row calls through the low-latency GEMM."""
+    if not supported():
+        logger.warning(f"FlashInfer mm_mxfp8 has no {BACKEND} backend here; skipped.")
+        return
+    for linear in linears:
+        if isinstance(linear.quant_method, Fp8LinearMethod):
+            linear.quant_method.mxfp8_cutedsl_override = _linear
+
+
+def _pinned_tactic(*, sm: int, n: int, k: int, rows: int):
+    if not MXFP8_MAX_ROWS // 2 < rows <= MXFP8_MAX_ROWS:
+        return None
+    return PINNED_TACTICS.get((sm, n, k))
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def pinned_tactics() -> Iterator[None]:
+    """While tuning, FlashInfer's low-latency tactic list is the pinned tactic alone
+    where one applies, so the autotuner caches it under its usual key on every rank."""
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_platform
+
+    sm = get_platform().device_sm
+    gemm = importlib.import_module(_GEMM_MODULE)
+    enumerate_tactics = gemm.autotune_tactics
+
+    def autotune_tactics(problem_sizes_mnkl, *args, **kwargs):
+        tactics = enumerate_tactics(problem_sizes_mnkl, *args, **kwargs)
+        # The runner computes out.T, so the problem is (N, M, K, L).
+        n, rows, k, _ = problem_sizes_mnkl
+        pinned = _pinned_tactic(sm=sm, n=n, k=k, rows=rows)
+        if pinned is None or pinned not in tactics:
+            return tactics
+        return [pinned]
+
+    gemm.autotune_tactics = autotune_tactics
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        gemm.autotune_tactics = enumerate_tactics
+
+
+def autotune(model: nn.Module, *, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+    """Tune buckets 1, 2, 4 and 8 with one 8-row call per weight shape; inside the
+    FlashInfer autotune context and `pinned_tactics`. The DSpark draft shares these
+    shapes and the process-wide tactic cache."""
+    from sglang.srt.layers.linear import LinearBase
+
+    by_shape = {}
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if (
+            isinstance(module, LinearBase)
+            and isinstance(module.quant_method, Fp8LinearMethod)
+            and module.quant_method.mxfp8_cutedsl_override is not None
+        ):
+            by_shape.setdefault(tuple(module.weight.shape), module)
+    # Sorted, so every rank of the tactic-timing reduce makes the same calls in order.
+    for shape in sorted(by_shape):
+        layer = by_shape[shape]
+        x = torch.zeros(
+            (MXFP8_MAX_ROWS, shape[1]), dtype=dtype, device=layer.weight.device
+        )
+        layer.quant_method.apply(layer, x)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""Low-batch routed-expert GEMMs for DeepSeek-V4.1 decode.
+
+A TP MoE layer (all experts local, intermediate 576
+padded to 640) replaces FlashInfer's TRT-LLM-gen routing + two batched GEMMs by a route
+kernel and a GEMM pair of 8-row tcgen05 block-scaled tiles (persistent schedule, PDL),
+compiled with NVRTC on first use. An expert chosen by more than 8 rows gets several
+consecutive tiles (route_wide.cu). The kernels read the same shuffled MXFP4 weights and
+MXFP8 activations as FlashInfer and return its deferred-finalize triple, so the fused
+finalize + all-reduce + mHC consumer is unchanged; layers that finalize locally (the
+DSpark draft) add finalize.cu, FlashInfer's small-batch finalize arithmetic.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ctypes
+import hashlib
+import json
+import logging
+import os
+from functools import cache
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+SOURCE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "routed_expert_gemm_src"
+
+HIDDEN = 5120
+SLICE = 576
+PADDED = 640
+MAX_EXPERTS = 384
+MAX_TOP_K = 8
+TILE = 8
+MAX_ROWS = 8
+WIDE_MAX_ROWS = 64  # route_wide.cu: one 64-bit row mask per expert
+GEMM1_UNITS = 9  # 128-row tiles of w13 holding the 576-wide slice (10th is padding)
+GEMM2_UNITS = HIDDEN // 128
+ROUTE_THREADS = 64
+ROUTE_WIDE_THREADS = 512
+FINALIZE_THREADS = 256  # one thread per output value, HIDDEN / 256 CTAs per row
+NVRTC_OPTIONS = ("-std=c++17", "-default-device", "--use_fast_math")
+HEADERS = ("route.cuh",)
+GEMM1_PARAMETERS = ("A", "SFA", "X", "XS", "route", "clamp", "H", "HS", "cta_words")
+GEMM2_PARAMETERS = ("A", "SFA", "H", "HS", "route", "Y", "cta_words")
+PARAMETERS = {"gemm1": GEMM1_PARAMETERS, "gemm2": GEMM2_PARAMETERS}
+
+
+def max_ctas(rows: int, top_k: int, experts: int) -> int:
+    """The most 8-row token tiles any routing of ``rows * top_k`` slots needs."""
+    slots = rows * top_k
+    filled = min(experts, slots)
+    return filled + (slots - filled) // TILE
+
+
+def cta_words(ctas: int) -> int:
+    return (ctas + 3) // 4 * 4
+
+
+def route_words(ctas: int) -> int:
+    """int32 length of the route record for ``ctas`` token tiles."""
+    return 4 + 2 * cta_words(ctas) + TILE * ctas
+
+
+def _driver():
+    from cuda.bindings import driver
+
+    return driver
+
+
+def _check(result: tuple, what: str) -> tuple:
+    if int(result[0]) != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{what} failed: {result[0]!r}")
+    return result[1:]
+
+
+def _include_dirs() -> list[str]:
+    candidates: list[Path] = []
+    for variable in ("CUDA_HOME", "CUDA_PATH"):
+        root = os.environ.get(variable)
+        if root:
+            candidates.append(Path(root) / "include")
+    candidates.append(Path("/usr/local/cuda/include"))
+    try:
+        import nvidia
+
+        for base in nvidia.__path__:
+            candidates.extend(sorted(Path(base).glob("*/include")))
+    except ImportError:
+        pass
+    found: list[str] = []
+    for directory in candidates:
+        if (directory / "cuda.h").is_file() and str(directory) not in found:
+            found.append(str(directory))
+            if (directory / "cccl" / "cuda" / "std").is_dir():
+                found.append(str(directory / "cccl"))
+    return found
+
+
+def nvrtc_version() -> tuple[int, int]:
+    from cuda.bindings import nvrtc
+
+    major, minor = _check(nvrtc.nvrtcVersion(), "nvrtcVersion")
+    return int(major), int(minor)
+
+
+def _cache_dir() -> Path:
+    from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+    return (
+        Path(os.path.expanduser(envs.SGLANG_CACHE_DIR.get()))
+        / "dsv41_routed_expert_gemm"
+    )
+
+
+def compile_source(
+    source: str,
+    name: str,
+    arch: str,
+    options: tuple[str, ...] = NVRTC_OPTIONS,
+    headers: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None,
+) -> bytes:
+    """Compile ``source`` to a cubin for ``arch`` with NVRTC, cached on disk by the
+    hash of source, headers, options and NVRTC version."""
+    from cuda.bindings import nvrtc
+
+    headers = dict(headers or {})
+    options = [f"--gpu-architecture={arch}", *options]
+    options += [f"-I{d}" for d in _include_dirs()]
+    if nvrtc_version() >= (12, 9):
+        options.append("--no-cache")
+    header_text = [f"{k}\0{v}" for k, v in sorted(headers.items())]
+    key = hashlib.sha256(
+        "\0".join([source, *header_text, *options, repr(nvrtc_version())]).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+    cached = _cache_dir() / f"{name}-{key[:24]}.cubin"
+    if cached.is_file():
+        return cached.read_bytes()
+    (program,) = _check(
+        nvrtc.nvrtcCreateProgram(
+            source.encode(),
+            f"{name}.cu".encode(),
+            len(headers),
+            [text.encode() for text in headers.values()],
+            [header.encode() for header in headers],
+        ),
+        "nvrtcCreateProgram",
+    )
+    try:
+        encoded = [option.encode() for option in options]
+        (status,) = nvrtc.nvrtcCompileProgram(program, len(encoded), encoded)
+        if int(status) != 0:
+            (size,) = _check(nvrtc.nvrtcGetProgramLogSize(program), "log size")
+            log = b" " * size
+            _check(nvrtc.nvrtcGetProgramLog(program, log), "nvrtcGetProgramLog")
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"NVRTC failed to compile {name}: {log.decode(errors='replace')}"
+            )
+        (size,) = _check(nvrtc.nvrtcGetCUBINSize(program), "nvrtcGetCUBINSize")
+        cubin = b" " * size
+        _check(nvrtc.nvrtcGetCUBIN(program, cubin), "nvrtcGetCUBIN")
+    finally:
+        nvrtc.nvrtcDestroyProgram(program)
+    cached.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = cached.with_suffix(f".{os.getpid()}.tmp")
+    temporary.write_bytes(cubin)
+    temporary.replace(cached)
+    return cubin
+
+
+class _Kernel(NamedTuple):
+    function: object
+    block: tuple[int, int, int]
+    shared_memory_bytes: int
+    cubin: bytes
+
+
+def _load(cubin: bytes, symbol: str, block, shared: int) -> _Kernel:
+    cu = _driver()
+    (module,) = _check(cu.cuModuleLoadData(cubin), "cuModuleLoadData")
+    (function,) = _check(cu.cuModuleGetFunction(module, symbol.encode()), symbol)
+    if shared > 48 * 1024:
+        _check(
+            cu.cuFuncSetAttribute(
+                function,
+                cu.CUfunction_attribute.CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES,
+                shared,
+            ),
+            "cuFuncSetAttribute",
+        )
+    return _Kernel(function, tuple(block), shared, cubin)
+
+
+@cache
+def load_kernels(device_index: int) -> dict[str, _Kernel]:
+    """Compile (or read from the cache) and load the route kernel and GEMMs."""
+    device = torch.device("cuda", device_index)
+    with torch.cuda.device(device):
+        torch.zeros(1, device=device)  # make the primary context current
+        major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)
+        arch = f"sm_{major}{minor}a"
+        facts = json.loads((SOURCE_DIR / "launch.json").read_text())
+        headers = {name: (SOURCE_DIR / name).read_text() for name in HEADERS}
+        kernels = {
+            "route": _load(
+                compile_source(
+                    (SOURCE_DIR / "route.cu").read_text(),
+                    "route",
+                    arch,
+                    headers=headers,
+                ),
+                "dsv41_routed_expert_route",
+                (ROUTE_THREADS, 1, 1),
+                0,
+            )
+        }
+        for name, fact in facts.items():
+            if tuple(fact["parameters"]) != PARAMETERS.get(name):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"{name}: unexpected launch.json parameters {fact['parameters']}"
+                )
+            source = (SOURCE_DIR / f"{name}.cu").read_text()
+            kernels[name] = _load(
+                compile_source(source, name, arch),
+                fact["symbol"],
+                fact["block"],
+                int(fact["shared_memory_bytes"]),
+            )
+        return kernels
+
+
+@cache
+def load_route_wide(device_index: int) -> _Kernel:
+    device = torch.device("cuda", device_index)
+    with torch.cuda.device(device):
+        torch.zeros(1, device=device)
+        major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)
+        source = (SOURCE_DIR / "route_wide.cu").read_text()
+        cubin = compile_source(source, "route_wide", f"sm_{major}{minor}a")
+        return _load(
+            cubin, "dsv41_routed_expert_route_wide", (ROUTE_WIDE_THREADS, 1, 1), 0
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def load_finalize(device_index: int) -> _Kernel:
+    device = torch.device("cuda", device_index)
+    with torch.cuda.device(device):
+        torch.zeros(1, device=device)
+        major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)
+        source = (SOURCE_DIR / "finalize.cu").read_text()
+        cubin = compile_source(source, "finalize", f"sm_{major}{minor}a")
+        return _load(cubin, "dsv41_routed_expert_finalize", (FINALIZE_THREADS, 1, 1), 0)
+
+
+def _pointer(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> ctypes.c_void_p:
+    return ctypes.c_void_p(tensor.data_ptr())
+
+
+def _launch(
+    kernel: _Kernel, grid: tuple[int, int, int], arguments: list, stream: int
+) -> None:
+    """Launch with programmatic stream serialization (PDL); graph-capturable."""
+    cu = _driver()
+    addresses = [
+        argument.getPtr()
+        if isinstance(argument, cu.CUtensorMap)
+        else ctypes.addressof(argument)
+        for argument in arguments
+    ]
+    pointer_array = (ctypes.c_void_p * len(addresses))(*addresses)
+    config = cu.CUlaunchConfig()
+    config.gridDimX, config.gridDimY, config.gridDimZ = grid
+    config.blockDimX, config.blockDimY, config.blockDimZ = kernel.block
+    config.sharedMemBytes = kernel.shared_memory_bytes
+    config.hStream = cu.CUstream(stream)
+    attribute = cu.CUlaunchAttribute()
+    attribute.id = (
+        cu.CUlaunchAttributeID.CU_LAUNCH_ATTRIBUTE_PROGRAMMATIC_STREAM_SERIALIZATION
+    )
+    attribute.value.programmaticStreamSerializationAllowed = 1
+    config.attrs = [attribute]
+    config.numAttrs = 1
+    _check(
+        cu.cuLaunchKernelEx(
+            config, kernel.function, ctypes.addressof(pointer_array), 0
+        ),
+        "cuLaunchKernelEx",
+    )
+
+
+def _weight_map(weights: torch.Tensor, m: int, k: int, chunks: int):
+    """TMA map of MXFP4 weights ``[E, m, k / 2]`` (16U4, 128B swizzle)."""
+    cu = _driver()
+    if weights.data_ptr() % 32:
+        raise ValueError("packed expert weights must be 32-byte aligned")
+    u64, u32 = cu.cuuint64_t, cu.cuuint32_t
+    (tensor_map,) = _check(
+        cu.cuTensorMapEncodeTiled(
+            cu.CUtensorMapDataType.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_16U4_ALIGN16B,
+            4,
+            weights.data_ptr(),
+            [u64(128), u64(m), u64(k // 128), u64(weights.size(0))],
+            [u64(k // 2), u64(64), u64(m * k // 2)],
+            [u32(128), u32(128), u32(chunks), u32(1)],
+            [u32(1)] * 4,
+            cu.CUtensorMapInterleave.CU_TENSOR_MAP_INTERLEAVE_NONE,
+            cu.CUtensorMapSwizzle.CU_TENSOR_MAP_SWIZZLE_128B,
+            cu.CUtensorMapL2promotion.CU_TENSOR_MAP_L2_PROMOTION_L2_256B,
+            cu.CUtensorMapFloatOOBfill.CU_TENSOR_MAP_FLOAT_OOB_FILL_NONE,
+        ),
+        "cuTensorMapEncodeTiled(weights)",
+    )
+    return tensor_map
+
+
+def _scale_map(scales: torch.Tensor, groups: int):
+    """TMA map of 128x4-layout scale bytes viewed as ``[bytes/256, 256]``."""
+    cu = _driver()
+    total = scales.numel() * scales.element_size()
+    if total % 256 or scales.data_ptr() % 16:
+        raise ValueError("weight scales must be whole 256-byte rows, 16-byte aligned")
+    u64, u32 = cu.cuuint64_t, cu.cuuint32_t
+    (tensor_map,) = _check(
+        cu.cuTensorMapEncodeTiled(
+            cu.CUtensorMapDataType.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_UINT8,
+            2,
+            scales.data_ptr(),
+            [u64(256), u64(total // 256)],
+            [u64(256)],
+            [u32(256), u32(2 * groups)],
+            [u32(1)] * 2,
+            cu.CUtensorMapInterleave.CU_TENSOR_MAP_INTERLEAVE_NONE,
+            cu.CUtensorMapSwizzle.CU_TENSOR_MAP_SWIZZLE_NONE,
+            cu.CUtensorMapL2promotion.CU_TENSOR_MAP_L2_PROMOTION_L2_256B,
+            cu.CUtensorMapFloatOOBfill.CU_TENSOR_MAP_FLOAT_OOB_FILL_NONE,
+        ),
+        "cuTensorMapEncodeTiled(scales)",
+    )
+    return tensor_map
+
+
+def check_weights(w13, w13_scale, w2, w2_scale, clamp, top_k: int) -> None:
+    """Raise ValueError unless the weights have the layout the kernels read."""
+    experts = w13.size(0)
+    expected = (
+        (w13, (experts, 2 * PADDED, HIDDEN // 2)),
+        (w13_scale, (experts, 2 * PADDED, HIDDEN // 32)),
+        (w2, (experts, HIDDEN, PADDED // 2)),
+        (w2_scale, (experts, HIDDEN, PADDED // 32)),
+    )
+    for tensor, shape in expected:
+        if (
+            tuple(tensor.shape) != shape
+            or tensor.element_size() != 1
+            or not tensor.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"expected a contiguous {shape} 1-byte tensor, got {tuple(tensor.shape)} {tensor.dtype}"
+            )
+    if experts % 32 or not 0 < experts <= MAX_EXPERTS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"expected a multiple of 32 local experts <= {MAX_EXPERTS}, got {experts}"
+        )
+    if not 1 <= top_k <= MAX_TOP_K:
+        raise ValueError(f"expected a top-k of 1-{MAX_TOP_K}, got {top_k}")
+    if (
+        clamp is None
+        or clamp.dtype != torch.float32
+        or tuple(clamp.shape) != (experts,)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("expected an FP32 [E] SwiGLU clamp limit")
+    # GEMM1 never reads w13's padding tile, so the padding must be zero, as must the
+    # matching K columns of w2.
+    if (
+        torch.count_nonzero(w13.view(torch.uint8)[:, 2 * SLICE :]).item()
+        or torch.count_nonzero(w2.view(torch.uint8)[:, :, SLICE // 2 :]).item()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("the intermediate padding of w13/w2 is not zero")
+
+
+class RoutedExpertGemm:
+    """The route kernel and GEMM pair bound to one MoE layer's weights."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        w13,
+        w13_scale,
+        w2,
+        w2_scale,
+        clamp,
+        top_k: int,
+        max_rows: int,
+        finalize: bool = False,
+    ):
+        w13, w13_scale = w13.view(torch.uint8), w13_scale.view(torch.uint8)
+        w2, w2_scale = w2.view(torch.uint8), w2_scale.view(torch.uint8)
+        check_weights(w13, w13_scale, w2, w2_scale, clamp, top_k)
+        if not MAX_ROWS <= max_rows <= WIDE_MAX_ROWS:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"max_rows {max_rows} is outside {MAX_ROWS}-{WIDE_MAX_ROWS}"
+            )
+        self.experts = int(w13.size(0))
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.max_rows = max_rows
+        self.kernels = load_kernels(w13.device.index)
+        self.route_wide = (
+            load_route_wide(w13.device.index) if max_rows > MAX_ROWS else None
+        )
+        # Calls that finalize locally (not deferred) take the pair only with this set.
+        self.finalize_kernel = load_finalize(w13.device.index) if finalize else None
+        # route.cu flips bit 31 of this word on every launch.
+        self.barrier = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=w13.device)
+        self._tensors = (
+            w13,
+            w13_scale,
+            w2,
+            w2_scale,
+            clamp,
+        )  # the maps hold their addresses
+        self.clamp = clamp
+        self.gemm1_maps = (
+            _weight_map(w13, 2 * PADDED, HIDDEN, 2),
+            _scale_map(w13_scale, 4),
+        )
+        self.gemm2_maps = (_weight_map(w2, HIDDEN, PADDED, 2), _scale_map(w2_scale, 1))
+
+    def supports(
+        self, x_quant, x_scale, topk_output, *, finalize: bool = False
+    ) -> bool:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopKOutputChecker
+
+        if finalize and self.finalize_kernel is None:
+            return False
+        if not TopKOutputChecker.format_is_standard(topk_output):
+            return False
+        topk_ids, topk_weights = topk_output.topk_ids, topk_output.topk_weights
+        rows = x_quant.size(0)
+        return (
+            1 <= rows <= self.max_rows
+            and topk_ids.dim() == 2
+            and topk_ids.size(1) == self.top_k
+            and tuple(x_quant.shape) == (rows, HIDDEN)
+            and x_quant.element_size() == 1
+            and x_quant.is_contiguous()
+            and x_scale is not None
+            and x_scale.element_size() == 1
+            and x_scale.is_contiguous()
+            and x_scale.numel() >= rows * HIDDEN // 32
+            and topk_weights.dtype == torch.float32
+        )
+
+    def apply(
+        self, x_quant, x_scale, topk_output, output: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    ):
+        """The MoE output as FlashInfer's deferred finalize returns it, or finalized
+        into ``output`` (BF16 [rows, 5120]) when given."""
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.flashinfer_trtllm import (
+            FlashInferTrtllmDeferredFinalizeOutput,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.token_dispatcher import StandardCombineInput
+
+        gemm2_out, expert_weights, permuted = self(
+            x_quant, x_scale, topk_output.topk_ids, topk_output.topk_weights
+        )
+        if output is not None:
+            self.finalize(gemm2_out, expert_weights, permuted, output)
+            return StandardCombineInput(hidden_states=output)
+        return StandardCombineInput(
+            hidden_states=FlashInferTrtllmDeferredFinalizeOutput(
+                gemm2_out=gemm2_out,
+                expert_weights=expert_weights,
+                # Flat [rows * top_k] slot -> row map, as FlashInfer's routed MoE returns it.
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=permuted.view(-1),
+                top_k=self.top_k,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def __call__(self, x_quant, x_scale, topk_ids, topk_weights):
+        """Route + GEMM1 + GEMM2 on the current stream; returns FlashInfer's
+        deferred-finalize triple (gemm2 rows, weights, slot -> permuted row)."""
+        rows, top_k = topk_ids.shape
+        device = x_quant.device
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream
+        ids = topk_ids.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
+        ctas = max_ctas(rows, top_k, self.experts)
+        permuted = torch.empty((rows, top_k), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        record = torch.empty(route_words(ctas), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        if rows > MAX_ROWS:
+            _launch(
+                self.route_wide,
+                (1, 1, 1),
+                [
+                    _pointer(ids),
+                    _pointer(permuted),
+                    _pointer(record),
+                    ctypes.c_int32(rows),
+                    ctypes.c_int32(top_k),
+                    ctypes.c_int32(self.experts),
+                ],
+                stream,
+            )
+        else:
+            _launch(
+                self.kernels["route"],
+                (1, 1, 1),
+                [
+                    _pointer(ids),
+                    _pointer(permuted),
+                    _pointer(record),
+                    _pointer(self.barrier),
+                    ctypes.c_int32(rows),
+                    ctypes.c_int32(top_k),
+                    ctypes.c_int32(self.experts),
+                ],
+                stream,
+            )
+        padded_rows = TILE * ctas
+        h_values = torch.empty((padded_rows, PADDED), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        h_scales = torch.empty(
+            (padded_rows + 127) // 128 * 128 * PADDED // 32,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        gemm2_rows = torch.empty(
+            (rows * top_k * TILE, HIDDEN), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+        )
+        words = ctypes.c_int32(cta_words(ctas))
+        _launch(
+            self.kernels["gemm1"],
+            (GEMM1_UNITS, ctas, 1),
+            [
+                *self.gemm1_maps,
+                _pointer(x_quant),
+                _pointer(x_scale),
+                _pointer(record),
+                _pointer(self.clamp),
+                _pointer(h_values),
+                _pointer(h_scales),
+                words,
+            ],
+            stream,
+        )
+        _launch(
+            self.kernels["gemm2"],
+            (GEMM2_UNITS, ctas, 1),
+            [
+                *self.gemm2_maps,
+                _pointer(h_values),
+                _pointer(h_scales),
+                _pointer(record),
+                _pointer(gemm2_rows),
+                words,
+            ],
+            stream,
+        )
+        return gemm2_rows, topk_weights.contiguous().view(rows, top_k), permuted
+
+    def finalize(self, gemm2_rows, expert_weights, permuted, output) -> None:
+        """output[t] = BF16(sum_k w[t, k] * gemm2_rows[permuted[t, k]]), FlashInfer's
+        small-batch finalize arithmetic; output is BF16 [rows, 5120], contiguous."""
+        rows, top_k = expert_weights.shape
+        _launch(
+            self.finalize_kernel,
+            (HIDDEN // FINALIZE_THREADS, rows, 1),
+            [
+                _pointer(gemm2_rows),
+                _pointer(permuted),
+                _pointer(expert_weights),
+                _pointer(output),
+                ctypes.c_int32(top_k),
+            ],
+            torch.cuda.current_stream(output.device).cuda_stream,
+        )
+
+
+def build(layer, clamp, *, finalize: bool = False) -> Optional[RoutedExpertGemm]:
+    """The pair for a TP MoE layer's processed weights; None (logged) when the
+    kernels cannot take them, and FlashInfer serves every batch. ``finalize``:
+    the layer's calls also finalize locally (the DSpark draft)."""
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.switch import ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS
+
+    try:
+        if layer.num_local_experts != layer.num_experts:
+            raise ValueError("expert parallelism: the pair needs every expert local")
+        return RoutedExpertGemm(
+            layer.w13_weight,
+            layer.w13_weight_scale_inv,
+            layer.w2_weight,
+            layer.w2_weight_scale_inv,
+            clamp,
+            top_k=layer.top_k,
+            max_rows=ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS,
+            finalize=finalize,
+        )
+    except (ValueError, ImportError, OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
+        logger.warning(
+            f"DSV4.1 routed-expert GEMMs not installed, FlashInfer kept: "
+            f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
+        )
+        return None

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""`--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode`: the deployment it is validated on, and
+the row bounds of its paths."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+
+# Row bounds per path, in tokens of one forward. Past a bound the stock kernel
+# runs. FlashInfer's cutedsl_low_latency MXFP8 GEMM takes at most 8 rows.
+MXFP8_MAX_ROWS = 8
+# Compressor, indexer weights_proj and wk: slower than the stock GEMMs past 8 rows
+# on GB300 (measured at 12 and 24 rows).
+LOW_M_BF16_MAX_ROWS = 8
+# Routed-expert GEMM pair; route_wide.cu takes 9-64 rows. 48 rows (DSpark verify
+# at batch 8) was measured faster than FlashInfer at every row count.
+ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS = 48
+# Gluon swap-AB sparse decode attention; FlashMLA is faster from 32 rows on GB300.
+SWAPAB_MAX_ROWS = 24
+# LM head on FlashInfer's CuTe DSL low-M BF16 GEMM; slower than cuBLAS at 24 rows.
+LM_HEAD_MAX_ROWS = 16
+# Rows of the wo_b mailbox (Lamport all-reduce + mHC): its decode overlap range.
+WO_B_MAILBOX_MAX_TOKENS = 16
+
+_GPU_SM = 103
+_TP_SIZE = 4
+
+
+def enabled() -> bool:
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec
+
+    return get_exec().features.enable_dsv41_low_latency_decode
+
+
+def deployment_violations(server_args: ServerArgs, model_type: str) -> List[str]:
+    """Every requirement of the switch that this deployment misses."""
+    from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolving_view
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import Backend
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import attn_dp_enabled_of, get_platform
+
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    platform = get_platform()
+    checks = (
+        ("a DeepSeek-V4.1 model", model_type == "deepseek_v41"),
+        (
+            f"an SM{_GPU_SM} GPU (GB300 / B300)",
+            platform.is_cuda and platform.device_sm == _GPU_SM,
+        ),
+        (f"--tp-size {_TP_SIZE}", cfg.tp_size == _TP_SIZE),
+        (
+            "--ep-size 1 (the routed-expert GEMMs serve all experts locally)",
+            cfg.ep_size == 1,
+        ),
+        ("--moe-a2a-backend none", cfg.moe_a2a_backend == "none"),
+        ("no pipeline parallelism", cfg.pp_size == 1),
+        ("no DP attention", not attn_dp_enabled_of(cfg)),
+        ("no context parallelism", cfg.attn_cp_size == 1),
+        ("one node", cfg.nnodes == 1),
+        ("--speculative-algorithm DSPARK", cfg.speculative_algorithm == "DSPARK"),
+        (
+            "the default DeepSeek-V4 attention backend",
+            cfg.dsv4_attn_backend in ("auto", "flashmla"),
+        ),
+        (
+            "decode CUDA graphs",
+            not cfg.disable_cuda_graph
+            and cfg.cuda_graph_config.decode.backend != Backend.DISABLED,
+        ),
+        ("no encoder SWA bounded replay", not cfg.enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay),
+        ("no decoder SWA bounded replay", not cfg.enable_decoder_swa_bounded_replay),
+        ("no two-batch overlap", not cfg.enable_two_batch_overlap),
+        ("no PD disaggregation", cfg.disaggregation_mode == "null"),
+        ("no LoRA", not cfg.enable_lora),
+        # The low-M LM head returns BF16 logits through its quant method.
+        ("no --enable-fp32-lm-head", not cfg.enable_fp32_lm_head),
+        ("no --rl-on-policy-target", cfg.rl_on_policy_target is None),
+        ("no deterministic inference", not cfg.enable_deterministic_inference),
+    )
+    return [requirement for requirement, met in checks if not met]
+
+
+def check_deployment(server_args: ServerArgs, model_type: str) -> None:
+    violations = deployment_violations(server_args, model_type)
+    if violations:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode is validated on one deployment; "
+            "this one needs: " + "; ".join(violations)
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""wo_b's GEMM epilogue stores its rows straight into the mailbox of the Lamport
+all-reduce + mHC kernel, so the attention boundary runs only the consumer."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.switch import MXFP8_MAX_ROWS
+
+
+class WoBPublisher:
+    """One mailbox and publishing GEMM per process, built collectively on the
+    first eager forward: symmetric memory cannot be allocated during capture."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, hidden: int, hc_mult: int, top_k: int):
+        self._hidden = hidden
+        self._hc_mult = hc_mult
+        self._top_k = top_k
+        self._all_reduce = None
+        self._gemm = None
+        self._built = False
+        # The partial wo_b rows the epilogue published, until the post consumes them.
+        self._published: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+
+    def _build(self, wo_b: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.lamport.all_reduce_mhc import (
+            AllReduceMHC,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.lamport.publishing_gemm import (
+            PublishingMxfp8Linear,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.mxfp8_linear import pinned_tactics
+        from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.switch import WO_B_MAILBOX_MAX_TOKENS
+
+        self._built = True
+        self._all_reduce = AllReduceMHC(
+            hidden_size=self._hidden,
+            hc_mult=self._hc_mult,
+            max_num_tokens=WO_B_MAILBOX_MAX_TOKENS,
+            top_k=self._top_k,
+            device=wo_b.weight.device,
+        )
+        self._gemm = PublishingMxfp8Linear(self._all_reduce)
+        # Compile before capture; a publish without its consumer would desync the
+        # mailbox, so nothing launches. Under an autotune pass this tunes wo_b, so
+        # it offers only the pinned tactics the plain projections use.
+        with pinned_tactics():
+            for num_tokens in range(1, MXFP8_MAX_ROWS + 1):
+                self._gemm.precompile(wo_b, num_tokens)
+
+    def publish(self, wo_b: torch.nn.Module, x) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        """wo_b's partial rows, also stored into the mailbox; None to decline. The
+        caller publishes only when the attention post runs the fused all-reduce."""
+        if not self._built:
+            if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+                return None
+            self._build(wo_b)
+        if self._published is not None:
+            # The previous rows reached an unfused completion; the mailbox would desync.
+            raise RuntimeError("published wo_b rows were not reduced by the fused post")
+        rows = (x[0] if isinstance(x, tuple) else x).shape[0]
+        if not self._gemm.supports(wo_b, rows):
+            return None
+        prepared = self._gemm.prepare(wo_b, x)
+        if prepared is None:
+            return None
+        self._published = self._gemm(wo_b, prepared)
+        return self._published
+
+    def take(self, partial: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        """Whether ``partial`` is the published output; its consumer must run next."""
+        if self._published is None or partial is not self._published:
+            return False
+        self._published = None
+        return True
+
+    def reduce(self, partial, residual, post_mix, comb, pre, norm_weight, norm_eps):
+        """The consumer of `take`n rows: (updated streams, normalized next input)."""
+        return self._all_reduce(
+            partial, residual, post_mix, comb, pre, norm_weight.detach(), norm_eps
+        )
+
+
+_publisher: Optional[WoBPublisher] = None
+
+
+class _LayerPublish:
+    """The publisher bound to one decoder layer: it publishes only when that layer's
+    attention boundary leaves the TP sum to the fused post (the mailbox consumer)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, layer: torch.nn.Module):
+        self._layer = layer
+
+    def __call__(self, wo_b: torch.nn.Module, x) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        rows = (x[0] if isinstance(x, tuple) else x).shape[0]
+        if not self._layer.defers_attn_sum(rows):
+            return None
+        return _publisher.publish(wo_b, x)
+
+
+def install(layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Let ``layer``'s attention publish wo_b into the shared mailbox."""
+    global _publisher
+    if _publisher is None:
+        _publisher = WoBPublisher(
+            hidden=layer.hc_cfg.hidden,
+            hc_mult=layer.hc_cfg.mult,
+            top_k=layer.config.num_experts_per_tok,
+        )
+    # A plain object, so the layer does not become a submodule of its attention.
+    layer.self_attn.wo_b_publish = _LayerPublish(layer)
+
+
+def take(partial: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return _publisher is not None and _publisher.take(partial)
+
+
+def reduce(partial, residual, post_mix, comb, pre, norm_weight, norm_eps):
+    return _publisher.reduce(
+        partial, residual, post_mix, comb, pre, norm_weight, norm_eps
+    )

+"""DSV4.1 wo_b publishing into the fused all-reduce from its GEMM epilogue
+(--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode), on 4 SM100-family GPUs with NVLink multicast.
+
+Per split-K tactic and row count: the published GEMM's output equals FlashInfer's
+low-latency GEMM with the same tactic, and the consumer's outputs equal the separate
+publish kernel's, bit for bit, over boundary sequences that cycle the three mailbox
+generations, mix both paths, delay one rank in turn and replay from a CUDA graph.
+The consumer also matches a torch all-reduce + mHC post + collapse + RMSNorm, and
+the per-layer publisher installed on a decoder layer takes the same path.
+
+Run with ``python test_dsv41_wo_b_publish.py --num-gpu 4``.
+"""
+
+import math
+import os
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed import parallel_state as ps
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.utils import multigpu_pytest_main
+from sglang.test.test_utils import publish_build_topology
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+HIDDEN, HC, K, TOP_K = 5120, 4, 2048, 6
+
+sm100_family = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] == 10),
+    reason="Requires SM100/SM103",
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def rank():
+    rank = int(os.environ["RANK"])
+    world_size = int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    ps.set_custom_all_reduce(False)
+    ps.init_distributed_environment(
+        world_size=world_size,
+        rank=rank,
+        local_rank=local_rank,
+        distributed_init_method="env://",
+    )
+    publish_build_topology(tp_size=world_size, world_rank=rank)
+    ps.initialize_model_parallel()
+    yield rank
+    ps.destroy_model_parallel()
+    ps.destroy_distributed_environment()
+
+
+def _linear(device, gen):
+    """wo_b as mxfp8_linear.install leaves it: an Fp8LinearMethod with the override."""
+    from flashinfer import mxfp8_quantize
+
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8LinearMethod
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import mxfp8_linear
+
+    w = torch.randn(HIDDEN, K, device=device, generator=gen) / math.sqrt(K)
+    w_q, w_sf = mxfp8_quantize(w.bfloat16(), is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+    method = object.__new__(Fp8LinearMethod)
+    method.mxfp8_cutedsl_override = mxfp8_linear._linear
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        weight=w_q.contiguous(),
+        weight_scale_inv_swizzled=w_sf.reshape(-1).contiguous(),
+        bias=None,
+        quant_method=method,
+    )
+
+
+def _activation(rows, device, gen):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import flashinfer_mxfp8_quantize
+
+    x = torch.randn(rows, K, device=device, generator=gen).bfloat16()
+    if rows > 1:
+        # A zero row: zero outputs, whose negative zeros the publish clears.
+        x[-1] = 0
+    q, sf = flashinfer_mxfp8_quantize(x, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True, alignment=32)
+    return q, sf.reshape(-1)
+
+
+def _flashinfer_gemm(linear, qa, tactic):
+    """FlashInfer's own low-latency GEMM with ``tactic`` (output, valid tactics)."""
+    from flashinfer.gemm import gemm_base
+
+    a, a_scale = qa
+    out = torch.empty(a.shape[0], HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=a.device)
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(a.device)
+    runner = gemm_base._cutedsl_low_latency_blockscaled_gemm_runner(
+        major * 10 + minor, True
+    )
+    workspace = gemm_base._get_cache_buf(
+        "mm_mxfp8_workspace", gemm_base.DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_SIZE, a.device
+    )
+    inputs = [
+        a,
+        linear.weight.t(),
+        a_scale,
+        linear.weight_scale_inv_swizzled,
+        torch.bfloat16,
+        out,
+        workspace,
+    ]
+    runner.forward(inputs, tactic=tactic)
+    return out, runner.get_valid_tactics(inputs, None)
+
+
+def _mixes(rows, device, rank):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(7 + rank)
+    return (
+        torch.randn(rows, HC, HIDDEN, device=device, generator=gen).bfloat16(),
+        torch.rand(rows, HC, device=device, generator=gen),
+        torch.randn(rows, HC, HC, device=device, generator=gen) * 0.1,
+        torch.rand(rows, HC, device=device, generator=gen),
+        torch.randn(HIDDEN, device=device, generator=gen).bfloat16(),
+    )
+
+
+def _torch_boundary(x, mix, group):
+    residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight = mix
+    y = x.float()
+    dist.all_reduce(y, group=group)
+    y = y.bfloat16().float()
+    streams = post.unsqueeze(-1) * y.unsqueeze(1) + (
+        comb.unsqueeze(-1) * residual.float().unsqueeze(2)
+    ).sum(dim=1)
+    streams = streams.bfloat16()
+    collapsed = (pre.unsqueeze(-1) * streams.float()).sum(dim=1)
+    normed = collapsed * torch.rsqrt(collapsed.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+    return streams, (normed * norm_weight.float()).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _equal(a, b):
+    return torch.equal(a.view(torch.int16), b.view(torch.int16))
+
+
+@sm100_family
+def test_wo_b_publish_matches_separate_publish(rank):
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.lamport.all_reduce_mhc import (
+        AllReduceMHC,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.lamport.publishing_gemm import (
+        PublishingMxfp8Linear,
+    )
+
+    tp_size = ps.get_tp_group().world_size
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{torch.cuda.current_device()}")
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        arm = AllReduceMHC(
+            hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+            hc_mult=HC,
+            max_num_tokens=16,
+            top_k=TOP_K,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        publisher = PublishingMxfp8Linear(arm)
+        gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(1000 + rank)
+        layers = [_linear(device, gen) for _ in range(2)]
+
+        def boundary(x, mix):
+            residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight = mix
+            return arm(x, residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight, 1e-6)
+
+        # Which path each boundary of a sequence takes (True: published). The
+        # sequence crosses the three generations several times on both paths.
+        pattern = (True, True, True, False, True, False, False, True, True)
+        for rows in (1, 6, 8):
+            qas = [_activation(rows, device, gen) for _ in layers]
+            mix = _mixes(rows, device, rank)
+            assert publisher.supports(layers[0], rows)
+            assert publisher.prepare(layers[0], qas[0]) is not None
+            _, valid = _flashinfer_gemm(layers[0], qas[0], None)
+            by_split = {}
+            for tactic in valid:
+                by_split.setdefault(tactic[3], tuple(tactic))
+            # The default tactic (what an untuned mm_mxfp8 runs) and the first
+            # without split-K and with split-K 4 (both epilogue branches).
+            tactics = list(
+                dict.fromkeys(
+                    [tuple(valid[0])] + [by_split[s] for s in (1, 4) if s in by_split]
+                )
+            )
+            for tactic in tactics:
+                expected_c = [
+                    _flashinfer_gemm(layer, qa, tactic)[0]
+                    for layer, qa in zip(layers, qas)
+                ]
+                for late in range(tp_size):
+                    for index, published in enumerate(pattern):
+                        li = index % len(layers)
+                        if rank == late:
+                            torch.cuda._sleep(20_000)
+                        if published:
+                            prepared = publisher.prepare(layers[li], qas[li])
+                            x = publisher(layers[li], prepared, tactic=tactic)
+                            assert _equal(x, expected_c[li]), (
+                                f"C differs: rows={rows} tactic={tactic}"
+                            )
+                            got = boundary(x, mix)
+                        else:
+                            got = boundary(expected_c[li].clone(), mix)
+                        # The separate publish kernel on the same C, one boundary
+                        # later, so the generations must line up across paths.
+                        reference = boundary(expected_c[li].clone(), mix)
+                        for a, b in zip(got, reference):
+                            assert _equal(a, b), (
+                                f"boundary differs: rows={rows} tactic={tactic} "
+                                f"late={late} step={index}"
+                            )
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+            # Against torch: the math SGLang's own fused attention boundary runs.
+            c = _flashinfer_gemm(layers[0], qas[0], tactics[0])[0]
+            streams, normed = boundary(
+                publisher(
+                    layers[0],
+                    publisher.prepare(layers[0], qas[0]),
+                    tactic=tactics[0],
+                ),
+                mix,
+            )
+            ref_streams, ref_normed = _torch_boundary(
+                c, mix, ps.get_tp_group().device_group
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                streams.float(), ref_streams.float(), atol=3e-2, rtol=2e-2
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                normed.float(), ref_normed.float(), atol=6e-2, rtol=3e-2
+            )
+
+            # One CUDA graph of published and separate boundaries, replayed.
+            tactic = tactics[0]
+            stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+            stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+            graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+            with torch.cuda.stream(stream), torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+                captured = []
+                for index, published in enumerate(pattern):
+                    li = index % len(layers)
+                    if published:
+                        prepared = publisher.prepare(layers[li], qas[li])
+                        x = publisher(layers[li], prepared, tactic=tactic)
+                    else:
+                        x = _flashinfer_gemm(layers[li], qas[li], tactic)[0]
+                    captured.append(boundary(x, mix))
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+            for _ in range(3):
+                graph.replay()
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                for index, outputs in enumerate(captured):
+                    li = index % len(layers)
+                    reference = boundary(
+                        _flashinfer_gemm(layers[li], qas[li], tactic)[0], mix
+                    )
+                    for a, b in zip(outputs, reference):
+                        assert _equal(a, b)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+
+@sm100_family
+def test_installed_layer_publish_matches_the_plain_projection(rank):
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import mxfp8_linear, wo_b_publish
+
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{torch.cuda.current_device()}")
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(2000 + rank)
+    defers = {"sum": True}
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(
+        hc_cfg=SimpleNamespace(hidden=HIDDEN, mult=HC),
+        config=SimpleNamespace(num_experts_per_tok=TOP_K),
+        self_attn=SimpleNamespace(),
+        defers_attn_sum=lambda rows: defers["sum"],
+    )
+    with torch.inference_mode(), patch.object(wo_b_publish, "_publisher", None):
+        wo_b = _linear(device, gen)
+        wo_b_publish.install(layer)
+        publish = layer.self_attn.wo_b_publish
+        for rows in (1, 6, 8):
+            qa = _activation(rows, device, gen)
+            residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight = _mixes(rows, device, rank)
+            # The plain projection mm_mxfp8 runs, with the tactic the publisher selects.
+            c = mxfp8_linear._linear(wo_b, qa, wo_b.weight_scale_inv_swizzled, None)
+            partial = publish(wo_b, qa)
+            assert partial is not None and _equal(partial, c)
+            assert wo_b_publish.take(partial)
+            got = wo_b_publish.reduce(
+                partial, residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight, 1e-6
+            )
+            # The unfused publish on the same mailbox: generations stay aligned.
+            all_reduce = wo_b_publish._publisher._all_reduce
+            want = all_reduce(c.clone(), residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight, 1e-6)
+            for a, b in zip(got, want):
+                assert _equal(a, b), f"rows={rows}"
+        defers["sum"] = False
+        assert publish(wo_b, _activation(6, device, gen)) is None
+        assert not wo_b_publish.take(c)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    multigpu_pytest_main(__name__, __file__, num_gpus=(4,))

+"""The sharded DSpark Markov chain kernel (--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode) draws
+MarkovSampleStep's tokens and keeps its step logits bit for bit when the bias products
+sum exactly: one rank and four ranks (spawned, symmetric memory), one to four rows,
+greedy and sampled temperatures, BF16 and FP32 base logits, local-shard and full-vocab
+base logits, three launches (epoch tags and both staging parities) and CUDA graph
+replay with the noise forked onto its side stream.
+"""
+
+import os
+import socket
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+VOCAB = 129_280  # DeepSeek-V4.1
+RANK = 256
+STEPS = 5
+MAX_BS = 8
+KEY = 0x1234_5678_9ABC_DEF
+TEMPERATURE_SETS = ((0.0,) * 8, (1.0,) * 8, (0.7, 1.3, 1.0, 0.0, 0.5, 2.0, 0.9, 1.1))
+
+
+def _gpu_ready() -> bool:
+    return torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] >= 10
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not _gpu_ready(), reason="needs an SM100-family GPU")
+
+
+def _ternary(g: torch.Generator, device, *shape: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Sparse {-1, 0, 1} BF16: |bias| <= 256, exact in BF16 in any summation order."""
+    values = torch.randint(-1, 2, shape, generator=g)
+    values *= torch.rand(shape, generator=g) < 0.25
+    return values.to(device, torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _reference(w1, w2, base, anchor, temperatures, offset, cache):
+    """MarkovSampleStep per step over the full vocab, as the unsharded draft step runs it."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.markov_sample import MarkovSampleStep
+
+    prev, tokens = anchor.long(), []
+    for step in range(base.shape[1]):
+        bias = F.linear(w1[prev], w2)
+        prev = MarkovSampleStep.execute(
+            base_logits=base[:, step],
+            bias=bias,
+            temperatures=temperatures,
+            key=KEY,
+            offset=offset,
+            step=step,
+            step_dtype=torch.float32,
+            logits_out=None if cache is None else cache[: base.shape[0], step],
+            has_sampled_rows=None if cache is not None else False,
+        )
+        tokens.append(prev)
+    return torch.stack(tokens, 1)
+
+
+def _check_equal(device, group, rank: int, world: int, base_dtype, seed: int):
+    from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.dspark.sharded_markov import (
+        ARRIVAL_WORDS,
+        TIMEOUT_MS,
+        DSparkShardedMarkovSampler,
+    )
+
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    w1, w2 = _ternary(g, device, VOCAB, RANK), _ternary(g, device, VOCAB, RANK)
+    sampler = DSparkShardedMarkovSampler(
+        embed_weight=w1,
+        head_weight=w2,
+        vocab_size=VOCAB,
+        num_steps=STEPS,
+        cache_dtype=torch.float32,
+        group=group,
+        rank=rank,
+        world=world,
+        max_bs=MAX_BS,
+        timeout_ms=TIMEOUT_MS,
+    )
+    shard = slice(rank * VOCAB // world, (rank + 1) * VOCAB // world)
+    offset = torch.tensor([3], dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    for rows in (1, 2, 4):
+        base = (torch.randn(rows, STEPS, VOCAB, generator=g) * 3).to(device, base_dtype)
+        anchor = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (rows,), generator=g).to(device)
+        for temps in TEMPERATURE_SETS:
+            temperatures = torch.tensor(temps, device=device)
+            for keep in (True, False):  # sampled draft vs greedy draft (no logits)
+                want_cache = (
+                    torch.zeros(MAX_BS, STEPS, VOCAB, device=device) if keep else None
+                )
+                want = _reference(
+                    w1, w2, base, anchor, temperatures[:rows], offset, want_cache
+                )
+                for local in (True, False):
+                    inputs = base[:, :, shard].contiguous() if local else base
+                    for _ in range(3):
+                        cache = (
+                            torch.zeros(MAX_BS, STEPS, VOCAB, device=device)
+                            if keep
+                            else None
+                        )
+                        tokens = torch.full(
+                            (MAX_BS, STEPS), -7, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+                        )
+                        if keep:
+                            sampler.launch_noise(rows=rows, key=KEY, offset=offset)
+                        sampler.sample(
+                            base_logits=inputs,
+                            anchor_tokens=anchor,
+                            temperatures=temperatures,
+                            logits_cache=cache,
+                            draft_tokens=tokens,
+                        )
+                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                        assert torch.equal(tokens[:rows], want), (
+                            rows,
+                            temps,
+                            keep,
+                            local,
+                        )
+                        if keep:
+                            assert torch.equal(cache[:rows], want_cache[:rows]), (
+                                rows,
+                                temps,
+                                local,
+                            )
+
+    # CUDA graph: noise forked onto the side stream, replayed with new offsets.
+    rows = 2
+    base = (torch.randn(rows, STEPS, VOCAB, generator=g) * 3).to(device, base_dtype)
+    anchor = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (rows,), generator=g).to(device)
+    temperatures = torch.tensor(TEMPERATURE_SETS[2], device=device)
+    cache = torch.zeros(MAX_BS, STEPS, VOCAB, device=device)
+    tokens = torch.full((MAX_BS, STEPS), -7, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    def forked_sample():
+        sampler.fork_noise(rows=rows, key=KEY, offset=offset)
+        sampler.join_noise()
+        sampler.sample(
+            base_logits=base[:, :, shard].contiguous(),
+            anchor_tokens=anchor,
+            temperatures=temperatures,
+            logits_cache=cache,
+            draft_tokens=tokens,
+        )
+
+    side = torch.cuda.Stream(device)
+    side.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(device))
+    with torch.cuda.stream(side):
+        forked_sample()
+    torch.cuda.current_stream(device).wait_stream(side)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        forked_sample()
+    for step_offset in (5, 6, 1 << 33):
+        offset.fill_(step_offset)
+        graph.replay()
+        want_cache = torch.zeros_like(cache)
+        want = _reference(w1, w2, base, anchor, temperatures[:rows], offset, want_cache)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        assert torch.equal(tokens[:rows], want)
+        assert torch.equal(cache[:rows], want_cache[:rows])
+    assert int(sampler.control[ARRIVAL_WORDS].abs().sum()) == 0  # arrivals reset
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("base_dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32])
+def test_one_rank_matches_markov_sample_step(base_dtype):
+    _check_equal(torch.device("cuda"), None, 0, 1, base_dtype, seed=1)
+
+
+def _free_port() -> int:
+    with socket.socket() as s:
+        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        return s.getsockname()[1]
+
+
+def _four_rank_worker(rank: int, world: int, port: int) -> None:
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"] = "127.0.0.1"
+    os.environ["MASTER_PORT"] = str(port)
+    device = torch.device("cuda", rank)
+    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
+    dist.init_process_group("cpu:gloo,cuda:nccl", rank=rank, world_size=world)
+    group = dist.new_group(list(range(world)), backend="gloo")
+    try:
+        for base_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+            _check_equal(device, group, rank, world, base_dtype, seed=7)
+        dist.barrier(group=group)
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(torch.cuda.device_count() < 4, reason="needs 4 GPUs")
+def test_four_ranks_match_markov_sample_step():
+    torch.multiprocessing.spawn(
+        _four_rank_worker, args=(4, _free_port()), nprocs=4, join=True
+    )

+"""DSV4.1 low-latency compressor projections: ll_bf16 dispatch, which layers take
+the low-M GEMMs, and the 1-8-row routing. GPU (SM100 family with CuTe DSL): the
+installed projections match the stock GEMMs at the served shapes."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci, register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4 import dsv41_sparse
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.dsv41_sparse import DeepseekV41Compressor
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import indexer as ll_indexer
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import ll_bf16
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.ll_bf16 import CompileKey, dispatch
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency.low_m_gemm import cutedsl_low_m_supported
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+HIDDEN = 5120
+HEAD_DIM = 512
+
+
+class TestLlBf16Dispatch(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_tuned_compressor_shapes(self):
+        # GB300 configs measured at the DSpark verify size.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            dispatch(M=6, K=5120, N=1024),
+            CompileKey(backend="splitk", split_k=4, num_stages=4),
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            dispatch(M=6, K=5120, N=512),
+            CompileKey(backend="dotprod", M=6, K=5120, bs=64),
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            dispatch(M=8, K=5120, N=512),
+            CompileKey(backend="splitk", split_k=4, num_stages=6),
+        )
+
+    def test_untuned_shapes_use_the_default_dispatch(self):
+        dotprod = CompileKey(backend="dotprod", M=3, K=5120, bs=128)
+        self.assertEqual(dispatch(M=3, K=5120, N=1024), dotprod)
+        # Narrow N would leave split-K with too few CTAs.
+        self.assertEqual(dispatch(M=7, K=5120, N=32).backend, "dotprod")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            dispatch(M=7, K=5120, N=512),
+            CompileKey(backend="splitk", split_k=6, num_stages=4),
+        )
+
+
+class TestLlBf16Operands(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_trainable_weight_reaches_the_kernel_detached(self):
+        """An nn.Linear weight requires grad; DLPack export of it fails at graph capture."""
+        seen = []
+        w = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1024, 5120, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+        x = torch.zeros(6, 5120, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                ll_bf16, "compile_kernel", return_value=lambda *a: seen.extend(a)
+            ),
+            patch.object(ll_bf16, "_stream", return_value=None),
+        ):
+            ll_bf16.ll_bf16_gemm(x, w)
+        tensors = [a for a in seen if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor)]
+        self.assertEqual(len(tensors), 3)
+        self.assertFalse(any(t.requires_grad for t in tensors))
+
+
+def _attn(compressor=True, indexer=True):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        compressor=SimpleNamespace(low_m_bf16_gemm=None, low_m_fp32_gemm=None)
+        if compressor
+        else None,
+        indexer=SimpleNamespace(low_m_gemm=None) if indexer else None,
+    )
+
+
+class TestInstallProjections(CustomTestCase):
+    def _install(self, attn, *, ll_bf16_ok=True, cutedsl_ok=True):
+        with (
+            patch.object(ll_indexer, "ll_bf16_supported", return_value=ll_bf16_ok),
+            patch.object(
+                ll_indexer, "cutedsl_low_m_supported", return_value=cutedsl_ok
+            ),
+        ):
+            ll_indexer.install_projections(attn)
+        return attn
+
+    def test_installs_on_the_compressor_and_indexer(self):
+        attn = self._install(_attn())
+        self.assertIsNotNone(attn.compressor.low_m_bf16_gemm)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(attn.compressor.low_m_fp32_gemm)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(attn.indexer.low_m_gemm)
+        # Layers without a compressor or an indexer take the other half alone.
+        self.assertIsNotNone(self._install(_attn(compressor=False)).indexer.low_m_gemm)
+        attn = self._install(_attn(indexer=False))
+        self.assertIsNotNone(attn.compressor.low_m_fp32_gemm)
+
+    def test_either_kernel_missing_installs_nothing(self):
+        for ll_bf16_ok, cutedsl_ok in ((False, True), (True, False)):
+            with self.subTest(ll_bf16=ll_bf16_ok, cutedsl=cutedsl_ok):
+                attn = self._install(
+                    _attn(), ll_bf16_ok=ll_bf16_ok, cutedsl_ok=cutedsl_ok
+                )
+                self.assertIsNone(attn.compressor.low_m_bf16_gemm)
+                self.assertIsNone(attn.compressor.low_m_fp32_gemm)
+                self.assertIsNone(attn.indexer.low_m_gemm)
+
+
+def _compressor(ratio, installed=True):
+    c = DeepseekV41Compressor(64, 32, ratio, 1e-6, fused_compress=True)
+    if installed:
+        attn = SimpleNamespace(compressor=c, indexer=None)
+        with (
+            patch.object(ll_indexer, "ll_bf16_supported", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(ll_indexer, "cutedsl_low_m_supported", return_value=True),
+        ):
+            ll_indexer.install_projections(attn)
+    return c
+
+
+class TestCompressorRouting(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_ratio2_fp32_projection_switches_at_1_to_8_rows(self):
+        c = _compressor(2)
+        bf16 = torch.bfloat16
+        with (
+            patch.object(ll_indexer, "_ll_bf16_gemm", return_value="ll") as ll,
+            patch.object(
+                dsv41_sparse, "linear_bf16_fp32", return_value="cublas"
+            ) as cublas,
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(c.project_fused(torch.zeros(1, 64, dtype=bf16)), "ll")
+            self.assertEqual(c.project_fused(torch.zeros(8, 64, dtype=bf16)), "ll")
+            self.assertEqual(c.project_fused(torch.zeros(9, 64, dtype=bf16)), "cublas")
+            self.assertEqual(
+                c.project_fused(torch.zeros(64, 6, dtype=bf16).T), "cublas"
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(ll.call_count, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(cublas.call_count, 2)
+
+    def test_ratio1_bf16_projection_switches_at_1_to_8_rows(self):
+        bf16 = torch.bfloat16
+        with patch.object(ll_indexer, "cutedsl_low_m_mm", return_value="ll") as ll:
+            self.assertEqual(
+                _compressor(1).project(torch.zeros(8, 64, dtype=bf16)), ("ll", None)
+            )
+            kv, _ = _compressor(1).project(torch.zeros(9, 64, dtype=bf16))
+            stock, _ = _compressor(1, installed=False).project(
+                torch.zeros(6, 64, dtype=bf16)
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(ll.call_count, 1)
+        for out, rows in ((kv, 9), (stock, 6)):
+            self.assertEqual((out.dtype, out.shape), (bf16, (rows, 32)))
+
+
+def _gpu_ok() -> bool:
+    return (
+        torch.cuda.is_available()
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] == 10
+        and ll_bf16.is_available()
+        and cutedsl_low_m_supported()
+    )
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(_gpu_ok(), "needs an SM100-family GPU with CuTe DSL")
+class TestCompressorKernels(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_kernels_match_fp32_reference_at_1_to_8_rows(self):
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        for n in (2 * HEAD_DIM, HEAD_DIM):
+            w = (torch.randn(n, HIDDEN, device="cuda", generator=g) * 0.02).bfloat16()
+            for rows in range(1, 9):
+                with self.subTest(n=n, rows=rows):
+                    x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, device="cuda", generator=g).bfloat16()
+                    want = x.float() @ w.float().T
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        ll_bf16.ll_bf16_gemm(x, w), want, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4
+                    )
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        ll_indexer.cutedsl_low_m_mm(x, w).float(),
+                        want,
+                        rtol=2**-7,
+                        atol=1e-2,
+                    )
+
+    def test_installed_compressor_matches_the_stock_one(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        for ratio in (1, 2):

+            torch.cuda._sleep(1_000_000)  # exposes a missing join

+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
